Testlio is an equal-opportunity employer deeply committed to creating an inclusive environment for people of all backgrounds and identities. We are female-founded, and half of our team members identify as women. For more information, see the DEI section of our website.

title: Software Engineer (Product) - London
description:
About Us

Teton is redefining the role of healthcare workers through cutting-edge AI technology and a great product experience. As populations get older and staff shortages grow, healthcare systems are under pressure. Our mission is to decrease the cost of healthcare while improving the quality of care.

Our product enables care teams to intervene, prevent and operate more efficiently. Our ambient sensors in resident rooms capture activity, sleep, respiration, gait and more. These signals are used both to react fast to risk events, like falls, and for long-term health analysis that care teams can act on.

Teton is scaling fast, operating in the Nordics, UK, DACH and US. We raised a $20M Series A. Expect travel to the US to meet users and team members.

We focus relentlessly on product excellence and user experience, deploying solutions at speed that make a tangible difference for carers. We are an aspiring meritocracy biased towards action, always striving to raise the bar. If you are driven by impact, speed and leveling up, this might be the place for you.

If you are looking for a 9-17 job, perform best with structure and struggle dealing with unknowns, this is not for you. We believe close collaboration between a hard-working, high-agency team enables the fastest and most efficient iteration cycles, helping us build an impactful product that healthcare professionals truly love to use.

The Job

We're looking for a talented and driven Product Engineer to own customer-facing features from the first conversation with a care team to the feature running in production. Care workers rely on our product during every shift and care managers use it to follow up on their residents, on mobile and on the web. This isn't a ticket-taking role. You'll talk to users, cut scope, build across the whole stack, and check afterwards whether what you shipped actually made a shift easier. Your goal is to shrink the time from a customer request to a deployed solution, without cutting corners on reliability or on the privacy of residents' health data.

In this role, you will focus on:

- Feature Development: Own features end-to-end, from design discussions through implementation to production rollout across multiple markets and languages, on the web app, the mobile app and the APIs behind them.

- Customer Insight: Talk to care staff and our customer success team every week, visit care facilities, and turn what you hear into clearly scoped product changes. Come with ideas, sketch the solution, and push it forward.

- Fast Iteration: Break large designs and features into small shippable pieces. Get MVPs in front of users quickly, measure how they're used, and iterate or kill them.

- Backend & APIs: Design and build the APIs, data models and services your features need. You will not just consume APIs, you will help shape, improve and fix the systems behind them.

- Quality, Privacy & Safety: Ship with care for health data: sensible access control, auditability and privacy by default. Build test coverage and use staged rollouts so new features never get in the way of the alerts care teams depend on.

Qualifications

- Strong TypeScript skills: this is the language for everything we build.

- Solid production experience with React on the web and/or React Native.

- Comfortable working across the stack: you've built backend APIs and worked with relational databases (e.g. Postgres), not just UI.

- Great product taste and a keen eye for UX. You work well with designers and can make sensible design decisions yourself when needed.

- Comfortable talking directly with non-technical users and turning messy feedback into concrete decisions.

- Previous startup experience and/or shipping a product where you owned the outcome, from idea to adoption.

- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work both independently and in a team.

Nice to Have

- Experience with React Native and Expo in production.

- AWS or equivalent cloud platform experience.

- Familiarity with TanStack, real-time systems or push notifications.

- Experience with health data or other regulated, privacy-sensitive domains (e.g. GDPR).

- Experience shipping products across multiple markets and languages.

What We Offer

- Participation in our warrant program (stock options).

- A small team where your decisions directly shape the product.

- Work on software that healthcare workers depend on every day, the impact is tangible and immediate.

Join Our Team

We're looking for individuals who share our vision and value ownership and entrepreneurship over a conventional job.

At Teton, you'll have the chance to make a real impact with your work.

If you're ready for more than just a job, come aboard and be part of our mission to transform healthcare.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Query
description:
Headquarters: Canada (Remote), United States (Remote), United Kingdom (Remote) Mexico City, Mexico - Hybrid

About CircleCI Engineering

CI/CD has been solved. Now it's being reinvented. AI agents don't just run pipelines. They write code, trigger builds, interpret failures, and propose fixes. The interfaces that developers use to understand and trust that work don't exist yet. We're building them.

At CircleCI, our guiding principles aren't posters on a wall. We learn fast: we run experiments, accept failure, and scale what works. We think like the customer: every decision connects back to the developer sitting in front of a failing build at 2 am. We own the outcome: not just our slice of it, but the whole thing. If that's how you already work, you'll fit here.

About the Query Team

Every pipeline, job, and test that runs on CircleCI generates data, and that history is one of our biggest advantages in an agentic software delivery lifecycle. Flaky test detection, test insights, pipeline search, and agents that reason about why a build failed all depend on fast, reliable access to it.

The Query team owns the system that makes this possible. We pull product data out of the transactional services that create it and store it in datastores built for historical and analytical workloads. We serve it through domain-level APIs to CircleCI's product teams and to customers through our public API. Our goal is to make storing data "fire and forget" for every other team, and querying it fast and dependable at a scale that keeps growing.

What You'll Do

- Build AI-natively. AI is how we work. It's not a productivity layer on top of engineering, but the default starting point for how problems get approached and solved.

- Shape how we store data at scale. Own and harden our ClickHouse-based storage layer. Design schemas for known and emerging access patterns, and tune ingestion and query performance to support production-scale data.

- Build the pipelines that move our data. Design and own ingestion from event streams and durable workflows built on Temporal. Data should arrive reliably, stay queryable while it's in transit, and never slow down the critical path of the services that produce it.

- Serve data to the product and to customers. Evolve our platform into the default path for historical queries. Make getting historical data easy, not a bottleneck. Teams should be able to get what they need quickly and with minimal hand-holding, while Query keeps enough visibility into how the data is used to optimize ingestion and reads across every consumer. Build in the indexing, caching, and tiered storage required to keep it performant.

- Set technical direction. When the problem is complex or the answer isn't obvious, you lead the design discussion, write up the architecture decision, and make the call. You help decide which data domain we migrate next and how.

- Champion observability. Use Honeycomb, Datadog, and Rollbar to understand ingestion lag, query latency, and data correctness. For a data platform, operational data drives stability, not just incident response.

- Keep things moving. You take ambiguous data problems from design to production quickly, and you help the people around you move faster too.

You don't just patch problems, you ask why they happened. You'll fix the immediate issue, then solve the underlying team practice, process, or system that let it through.

What You'll Bring

- AI-native engineering practices. You use AI tools daily and can speak to what you've built, where they changed your approach, and where they fall short.

- Hands-on data experience. You've built or owned data-intensive systems such as ingestion pipelines, event-driven architectures, or analytical and time-series datastores. You understand the tradeoffs between transactional and analytical storage, and you've designed schemas and tuned queries for high-volume workloads. Experience with ClickHouse or another columnar database is a strong plus.

- Backend depth in Go. You're strong in Go, or strong in a comparable language and eager to work in Go: interface design, data modeling, service integration, and concurrency. Familiarity with React and TypeScript is a plus, since you'll occasionally work on the product surfaces that display this data.

- Distributed systems judgment. You understand delivery guarantees, idempotency, backpressure, and failure recovery. You know when to rely on a framework's reliability guarantees rather than building your own.

- Technical leadership. You've led the design of complex systems and made tradeoffs deliberately. You leave foundations others can build on. You raise the quality bar through reviews, mentoring, and direct feedback, not just through the code you write.

- A track record of shipping. 5+ years building and operating production backend systems. Your work has served real users, and you've treated latency, reliability, and correctness as design concerns.

Sound like you?

You care about how data powers the product, not just where it lives. You know how to make a datastore fast at scale, and have tuned schemas and queries against real production load. You think like a platform engineer, measuring your work by how much it unblocks the teams building on it. AI isn't a tool you reach for occasionally; it's a core part of how you approach and solve problems. If that sounds like you, we want to talk.

We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time. 

About your role 

As a Staff Software Engineer at Juniper Square, you are a technical leader - setting technical direction, driving architectural decisions, and raising engineering quality across your team. This is a player-coach role: you lead through code and architecture, not just direction. You'll write production code as a hands-on individual contributor while owning your team's technical strategy, roadmap, and growth, and you'll collaborate closely with product, design, and QA to turn complex workflows into delightful, intuitive experiences.

We're hiring a Staff Software Engineer for the following team: 

- 
Treasury: Join the team building Juniper Square's Treasury platform, the system that brings transactions, balances, and bank data into and across the platform. You'll work on expanding bank integrations, a visualization and reporting layer for payments and treasury data, and vendor exports that connect treasury data to accounting, on a team that has already processed $500M+ in transactions.

What you'll do 

Own Technical Direction & Architecture 

- 
Set the technical direction and own the architecture for your domain's systems, from design through production

- 
Lead technical design for ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives - evaluating tradeoffs, aligning stakeholders, and driving implementation

- 
Be instrumental in your team's transition from monolith to service-oriented architecture

- 
Evaluate and select technologies with a bias toward what ships well and scales sustainably

Build & Deliver 

- 
Write production code as a hands-on individual contributor - this is not a role that delegates implementation to others

- 
Own end-to-end delivery of roadmap projects: design, coding, testing, and production

- 
Manage your team's short-term roadmap (spanning the next two quarters), proactively surfacing execution, cost, and technical risks and driving pragmatic mitigation

- 
Lead the development of complex, full-stack workflows, working across frontend and backend engineers

AI Fluency & AI-Native SDLC 

- 
Practice AI Fluency across the full software development lifecycle - deliberately choosing where AI versus traditional software is the right tool, and defending those tradeoffs against real criteria (latency, accuracy, cost, data sensitivity, explainability)

- 
Champion and embed AI-native development practices and tools (e.g., Cursor, Augment) to drive significant productivity gains across your team

- 
Adapt code review and testing practices for an AI-assisted SDLC - catching AI-specific failure modes (hallucinated dependencies, overconfident but incorrect logic) before they ship

- 
Build and evaluate agentic workflows and AI-assisted systems where they add real value, with clear human-in-the-loop boundaries and monitoring for failure

- 
Guard against over-reliance on AI tooling, in your own work and in the code you review, balancing velocity with system comprehension and accountability for outcomes

- 
Foster a culture of rapid iteration, high velocity, and quality, and help raise AI fluency across the team

Lead & Grow the Team 

- 
Mentor engineers, raise the quality of technical decision-making, and help the team execute with consistency

- 
Establish coding standards, review practices, and architectural documentation that scale as the team grows

- 
Partner with recruiting to build and grow the team

Collaborate Cross-Functionally

Work closely with product, design, QA, and customer support to translate requirements into executable technical plans

- 
Participate actively in design reviews and roadmap discussions with a grounded, implementation-level perspective

- 
Handle most cross-team conflicts and technical decisions autonomously

Operational Excellence 

- 
Own monitoring, diagnosing, and resolving production issues within your team's services

- 
Use observability tooling to measure and improve system performance and reliability

- 
Implement and uphold best practices that maximize developer productivity across the team

Domain Expertise 

- 
Grow into a subject-matter expert in your domain, with an in-depth understanding of customer needs and the value your systems deliver

Qualifications 

Required

12+ years of experience in backend and/or full-stack software engineering, with a clear trajectory of increasing technical leadership, architectural responsibility, and mentorship

A portfolio of shipped production systems - be ready to walk through specific technical decisions you personally made and code you personally wrote; this is not a role for someone whose primary contribution has been directing others

Deep expertise in at least one server-side language (Python preferred, Node/TS, Java, C++, C#, or similar) and strong proficiency building production-grade backend services

- 
Experience with modern front-end frameworks (React preferred) and comfort working full-stack when the problem calls for it

- 
Experience with relational/NoSQL databases, including schema design, performance tuning, and data modeling

- 
Experience building and operating cloud-native systems using AWS (or equivalent), Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure as code

- 
Strong understanding of CI/CD, observability, reliability, and operational excellence in production environments

- 
Deep understanding of service-oriented architecture and experience evolving systems from monolith toward SOA

- 
Demonstrated ability to raise engineering quality through technical standards, design reviews, mentoring, and reusable platform patterns

- 
Hands-on experience with AI-native development tools (e.g., Cursor, Augment) and a track record of using them to accelerate personal and team velocity

- 
Demonstrated AI Fluency: hands-on experience building AI-assisted or agentic systems with a deliberate, defensible point of view on when AI is (and isn't) the right tool; adapted code review practices to catch AI-specific failure modes; and concrete safeguards against over-reliance on AI tooling

Ability to work through ambiguity, break down complex problems, and drive alignment across engineering, product, and design

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent work experience

Nice to Have

Experience running paid media campaigns for B2B SaaS, hosting, PaaS, or other technical products, and familiarity with WordPress or cloud platforms.

Proficiency in other languages and experience managing non-English paid media campaigns

We take ownership of the entire analytical lifecycle, from initial question to final business decision, ensuring Affirm grows efficiently and intelligently.

About the role 

The Collections & Recoveries Analyst will own and drive the collections and recoveries strategy for Affirm Canada, spanning the full post-delinquency lifecycle from early-stage digital and outbound collections through third-party recovery-agency placement and post-charge-off recoveries, partnering closely with Product and Compliance to ensure collections and recoveries practices meet Canadian federal and provincial consumer protection, collections, and privacy requirements. The analyst will be responsible for owning and driving the collections and recoveries roadmap for the market, quantifying the impact of new collections and recovery initiatives, and monitoring downstream performance.

The ideal candidate will have a combination of strong analytical expertise with a deep understanding of consumer credit and collections behaviour, and the ability to improve recovery outcomes through data-driven insights, vendor management, and cross-functional stakeholder management.

Come join us in our mission to change consumer finance through better data and technology, lower costs, and increased transparency while providing the best customer experience.

What you’ll do 

You will own the full Canadian post-delinquency lifecycle: digital and outbound collections, third-party agency placement, and post-charge-off recoveries.

- Collections channel strategy. Own the digital and calling collections mix: comms cadence and sequencing, day-of-week and channel optimisation, outbound calling strategy, and the experiments that prove what drives repayment.

- Recoveries Strategy. Own recoveries strategy and performance analytics: recovery rates, cost-to-collect, placement mix, liquidation curves, and vendor scorecards

- Strategy and roadmap ownership. Set and iterate the Canadian collections and recoveries strategy across delinquency, roll rates, agency performance, and charge-off / net-after-charge-off outcomes. You will identify, size and drive initiatives to improve collections and recoveries performance. 

- Initiative design and quantification. Take collections and recoveries initiatives from hypothesis to launch to measured impact: sizing the opportunity up front, developing A/B experiment frameworks, and proving the result afterwards.

- Regulatory partnership. Work with Product, Legal and Compliance so that every treatment you design holds up against Canada's distinctive regulatory landscape: province-by-province collection-agency and consumer protection legislation, Quebec's separate civil-law regime and consumer credit rules, and federal and provincial privacy laws.

- Cross-market leverage. Partner with collections and recoveries teams across other geographies, particularly the US, to drive cross-market leverage. 

What we look for 

- 5-7+ years in credit risk, collections, or recoveries strategy analytics in consumer lending.

- Experience designing or optimising collections and/or recoveries strategies leveraging data, analytics and insights. 

- Very strong analytical background with proficiency in SQL, Python, or other scripting languages.

- Demonstrated ability to interpret credit and collections performance data and translate it into action.

- Knowledge of collections, recoveries, and delinquency management practices. Familiarity with Canadian consumer protection, collections, and privacy regulations (e.g., provincial consumer protection / collection-agency legislation, PIPEDA) is a plus.

- Excellent cross-functional communication and stakeholder management with ability to communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

- A passion for finding insights in data and driving change based on those insights.

- Intelligence + Humility. Hubris is the fastest way to blow up a business!

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Marketing Technology
description:

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. 

The Community You Will Join: 

Our mission at Marketing Technology is to provide a state-of-the-art platform and measurement capabilities to enable marketing and product teams to engage with our customers effectively. Every day, millions of Airbnb customers are reached via our streamlined platform over comprehensive marketing channels such as Email, Push, SMS, Google Ads, Facebook Ads etc. We deliver substantial business impact by enabling numerous stakeholders across the company, including Marketing (Brand and Performance), Guest, Host, Airbnb Org, Policy, and more.

The Difference You Will Make: 

As a Senior Staff Software Engineer on the Content Platform team, you'll set the technical direction for the org's transformation into an AI-driven system that turns a marketing brief into a fully realized campaign in minutes, not months. You'll own the technical strategy across a complex, multi-team surface area spanning a CMS platform, no-code authoring tools, rendering infrastructure, and an emerging agentic layer, all operating at a scale where the content produced is consumed by millions of Airbnb users daily. You will partner with engineering leadership, product, design, and marketing stakeholders across the company to define multi-year technical strategy, resolve the org's hardest cross-team technical challenges, and raise the bar for engineering excellence across Marketing Technology.

A Typical Day: 

As a Senior Staff Software Engineer on Content Platform, you will:

- Define and drive technical vision and strategy for the Content Platform org, ensuring architectural decisions scale across teams and align with broader company technology direction.

- Identify and resolve the highest-leverage, most ambiguous technical problems that span multiple teams or systems, often before they become visible to others.

- Lead architecture and design reviews across the org, setting technical standards and driving consistency in engineering practices.

- Mentor and grow Staff and senior engineers, and act as a technical multiplier by scaling your judgment and expertise across the broader organization.

- Partner directly with engineering leadership, product, design, and marketing/business stakeholders to align technical strategy with business priorities and influence roadmap decisions at the org level.

- Represent Marketing Technology in company-wide technical forums, driving adoption of best practices and shaping technical direction beyond your immediate team.

- At Senior Staff level, our engineers are expected to operate with organization-wide scope and impact, setting technical direction that shapes how multiple teams build and scale, while remaining deeply hands-on when it matters most.

Your Expertise: 

- 15+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, including a track record of technical leadership at organizational scale

- Bachelor's and/or Master's/PhD degree, preferably in CS, or equivalent experience

- Deep expertise in backend systems and large-scale, service-oriented and distributed architectures

- Proven experience architecting and scaling agentic or AI-driven systems in production

- Experience with Java, and/or Kotlin, LangGraph, GraphQL, relational and NoSQL databases, caching solutions like Redis, and microservice architecture

- Demonstrated ability to set technical vision and drive execution across multiple teams and stakeholders, with a track record of influencing engineering culture and standards beyond a single team

- Passionate about efficiency, availability, and system quality at scale

- Past experience with Marketing Technology or Growth platform systems is a plus

- Exceptional communication and cross-functional influence skills, with experience driving initiatives that span teams, departments, and leadership

Your Location: 

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list . Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging: 

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. title: Staff Software Engineer, On-Prem
description:
Headquarters: Canada (Remote) or United States (Remote) or Mexico City, Mexico (Hybrid)

About CircleCI Engineering

CI/CD has been solved. Now it's being reinvented. AI agents don't just run pipelines. They write code, trigger builds, interpret failures, and propose fixes. The interfaces that developers use to understand and trust that work don't exist yet. We're building them.

At CircleCI, our guiding principles aren't posters on a wall. We learn fast: we run experiments, accept failure, and scale what works. We think like the customer: every decision connects back to the developer sitting in front of a failing build at 2 am. We own the outcome: not just our slice of it, but the whole thing. If that's how you already work, you'll fit here.

About the On-Prem Team

The On-Prem team ships CircleCI Server, our self-hosted CI/CD platform for customers who need to run everything inside their own infrastructure: regulated industries, air-gapped environments, and teams with strict data residency and compliance requirements. Our mission is to deliver an on-premises CircleCI that is secure, highly available, and easy to install, upgrade, and support.

Our team serves two kinds of customers: the organizations that run Server, and the CircleCI engineering teams whose services ship inside it. Beyond the product itself, we own the tooling and infrastructure that let those teams package, test, and release their services into Server and keep them current. As a Staff Engineer here, you'll care as much about the internal release experience as about making Server reliable and easy to operate for external customers.

What You'll Do

- Build AI-natively. AI is how we work. It's not a productivity layer on top of engineering, but the default starting point for how we approach and solve problems.

- Make shipping into Server easy for every team. Own the platform strategy, setting the technical direction for the tooling, test infrastructure, and release automation that CircleCI teams use to develop and maintain their services inside Server.

- Give customers confidence installing, upgrading, and running CircleCI Server. Customers run Server in environments you'll never see. Make the install experience simpler and more predictable, upgrades safer, and day-to-day operation easier, starting with sensible defaults.

- Own Server's foundation. You'll be responsible for everything from the Kubernetes infrastructure Server deploys into, to the tooling internal teams and customers depend on. That responsibility extends past your own code to the systems and teams around it.

- Get operators from symptom to root cause fast. Standardize Server's observability on OpenTelemetry so it works with whatever platform each customer already runs. Build diagnostics that help operators, and the engineers supporting them, find the problem quickly. Partner with Support, Customer Engineering, and customers to find recurring issues and fix them at the source.

- Connect engineering to the business. Partner directly with Product and Engineering Management to translate business goals into technical strategy. You understand the "why" behind the roadmap and use it to make tradeoffs.

What You'll Bring

- A platform mindset. You default to building tools, frameworks, and systems that make other engineers more productive rather than solving each problem one-off. You've built internal platforms before and can talk about the leverage they created for the teams that used them.

- AI-native engineering practices. You use AI tools daily and can speak to what you've built, where they changed your approach, and where they fall short.

- Deep experience with Kubernetes and Helm. You've designed, deployed, and debugged production systems on Kubernetes. You know where the sharp edges are, especially in customer-operated environments (air-gapped, restricted network, unfamiliar cluster shapes).

- Strong backend and systems foundation. 8+ years building production backend and infrastructure systems, with a history of taking accountability for outcomes. Strong in Go, with real experience in API design, data modelling, distributed systems, and operational tooling.

- System design with business context. You make architecture decisions that span multiple systems and teams, weigh tradeoffs against business needs, and document your reasoning. You're the person others escalate to when the answer isn't obvious.

- Technical leadership. You mentor engineers, give direct feedback on technical direction, and raise the quality bar across teams through how you engage in reviews and design discussions, not just what you ship.

- Experience with on-premises or self-hosted software. You've shipped software that runs in someone else's environment (enterprise on-prem, self-hosted SaaS, or a distributed system installed by customers), and you understand how that constraint shapes your design choices, release process, and support model.

Sound Like You?

You believe the best platform work makes everyone else faster. You're energized by the challenge of building software that has to work in environments you can't see or control. You want to take a product customers depend on and make it dramatically easier to build, ship, and run, both for them and for the teams whose services live inside it. If that sounds like you, let's talk.

$195,000 — $265,000 CAD 

Expected salary range for San Francisco and the surrounding area.

$205,000 — $285,000 USD 

Expected salary range for specific metro areas including Boston, Washington DC, Denver, Los Angeles, New York, Portland, San Diego, and Seattle. These metro areas may change periodically.

$200,000 — $275,000 USD

$180,000 — $250,000 USD

About CircleCI 

CircleCI is the world’s largest continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) platform, and the hub where code moves from idea to delivery. As one of the most-used DevOps tools - processing more than 3 million jobs a day - CircleCI has unique access to data on how the most effective engineering teams work, and the tools to help software companies successfully leverage the power of AI into their commercial applications. Companies like Hinge, HuggingFace, and Samsung use us to improve engineering team productivity, release better products, and get to market faster.

Founded in 2011 and headquartered in downtown San Francisco with a global, remote workforce, CircleCI is venture-backed by Base10, Greenspring Associates, Eleven Prime, IVP, Sapphire Ventures, Top Tier Capital Partners, Baseline Ventures, Threshold
Ventures, Scale Venture Partners, Owl Rock Capital, Next Equity Partners, Heavybit, and Harrison Metal Capital. 

CircleCI is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

How CircleCI Uses AI in Hiring 

At CircleCI, people make our hiring decisions. We use technology to support our recruiting team so they can spend more time on what matters most: getting to know you.

Where we may use AI 

- Job descriptions and messaging : AI may help draft job descriptions and role-specific messaging so they are clear and accurate.

- Application review : For some roles, we use an AI tool to review applications, including resumes and application responses, against criteria our hiring team sets for the role. The tool generates a fit score and summary to help recruiters organize and prioritize applications. 

- Interview notes : With advance notice, an AI note-taking tool may join interviews to record, transcribe, and summarize the conversation. This lets interviewers focus on talking with you. You will be told before each interview, and you may opt out at any stage by letting your recruiter know. If you opt out, the tool will not join, and your candidacy is not affected.

- Outreach : AI may help draft candidate outreach and scheduling messages, which our team reviews before sending.

Our commitment 

AI does not make hiring decisions at CircleCI. Our recruiters and hiring teams review candidates and make every decision to advance or reject an application. No candidate is rejected based solely on an AI score. We have tools and processes in place to test for bias and to review how these tools perform, and we adjust our approach as AI technology and the laws that govern it change.

Your choices 

You can ask for human-only review of your application, opt out of AI interview note-taking, request an accommodation, or ask questions about how we use AI. Contact recruiting@circleci.com . For how we handle your data, including retention, see our Privacy Policy.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Who we are 

At Twilio , we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work , and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work 

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! 

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
. 

See yourself at Twilio 

Join the team as Twilio’s next Software Engineer .

About the job 

This position will be part of a team of talented engineers within our Commerce Platform Team, who build services and products that operate at a massive scale. This platform is central to Twilio's core business as it is responsible for managing the billing lifecycle and payment experience for our customers, while also acting as a gateway for discovering and selling our products. Billing is going through a transformational journey, and we are introducing new and exciting capabilities. The engineer in this role will be part of a team that focuses on the control plane, billing experience and account lifecycle management.=

The successful candidate will design, build, and operate core billing platform services that help transition our platform and our customers to the next generation architecture. These services work for all Twilio customers, regardless of their scale and billing complexity.

The ideal candidate will build high-quality, innovative and fully performing software that complies with high levels of coding standards and technical design. This is to build and integrate services that continuously improve our ability to provide products to customers while simultaneously delivering industry leading availability. We do this by leveraging technologies that include AWS cloud infrastructure and APIs, Apache Kafka, Rest APIs (OpenAPI compliance), while also building our own services.

Responsibilities 

In this role, you’ll:

- Improve your knowledge of highly available and scalable distributed systems and use this knowledge to build new features into our platform.

- Design, implement, and operate both new features on our current services as well as new services that will be built from scratch.

- Leverage your excellent communication and written skills to articulate the "why" of the solution you are proposing, and have a good understanding of your team’s priorities and the customer impact.

- Troubleshoot and fix operational issues and have the opportunity to improve the troubleshooting procedures and tools.

- Execute full software development life cycle (SDLC).

- Develop flowcharts and documentation to identify solutions.

- Write well-designed, testable code.

- Document and maintain software functionality.

- Troubleshoot, debug and upgrade existing systems.

Qualifications 

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required: 

- 0-2 years of work experience building highly scalable products.

- Experience of programming in object-oriented language (Java or similar) with clean code practices.

- Knowledge in Object-Oriented Programming with a successful track record.

- Experience with relational and non-relational databases.

- Collaborating with internal/external teams/engineers and fostering an inclusive environment, where all points of view are welcomed and encouraged.

- Self driven - you take complete ownership of your tasks and champion efforts to get your tasks to completion.

- Clear written and spoken communication skills.

- Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

Desired: 

- 

- Familiarity in Cloud Solutions, AWS, Kubernetes/EKS, CI/CD pipelines, Testing & Automation. 

- Experience delivering high levels of observability and proficiency in improving early warning systems, for example: has worked with Grafana/DataDog/Prometheus.

- Experience with on-call support for mission-critical customer systems.

- Experience optimizing and debugging SQL queries.

- Experience working on customer-facing applications.

- Good debugging skills on production systems.

- Proficient in Linux and containerization with Kubernetes.

- Nice to have skills: gRPC, Python, Typescript, React, Apache Kafka.

Location 

This role will be remote, and based in Ireland.

Travel 

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer 

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

. 

Twilio thinks big. Do you? 

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic . Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions. 
. 

Stay alert to recruitment fraud 

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

title: Senior AI Solution Specialist
description:
Do you want to help an entire organisation turn AI opportunities into solutions that deliver real business value, while still being the person who gets hands-on and builds those solutions? 

As Senior AI Solution Specialist at Sunweb Group, you take the lead on our more complex AI initiatives. You turn ambiguous business challenges into working prototypes and scalable solutions, while actively building, configuring and testing those solutions yourself.

You’ll join our five-person Architecture team and work closely with the AI PMO, connecting business teams with architecture, product, engineering, data and security.

This is a hands-on senior technical role, not a purely strategic, architectural or people-management position. Seniority here means tackling more complex challenges, having greater autonomy and impact, and helping others grow. We’re looking for someone who has recent practical experience building technical solutions and wants to continue doing so. You’ll design, prototype, configure, integrate and build, while also providing technical direction when needed.

Location: Rotterdam (Hybrid – 50% in office) 
Start Date: January/February 2027 

Availability : Fulltime 

Your impact 

- Lead complex AI discovery 
Turn unclear, cross-functional or strategically important business challenges into concrete AI opportunities. Take them from problem definition and validation through to a working prototype.

- Build AI solutions yourself 
Design, develop, configure and test agents, assistants and automated workflows that connect different departments, data sources and systems. You won’t only define what should be built or hand it over to others. You’ll be actively involved in building it.

- Shape enterprise AI initiatives 
Identify when an AI solution needs to move beyond experimentation into a business-critical or customer-facing product, and work with product and engineering teams to make that transition successful.

- Design for production 
Define solution architecture, integrations and non-functional requirements, while considering scalability, security, supportability, cost and business value.

- Create reusable AI patterns 
Develop approaches for grounding, identity, integration, monitoring and evaluation that can be reused across teams, and identify opportunities for shared AI capabilities.

- Coach and challenge others 
Review solutions, share technical expertise and coach colleagues and business users. You’ll work closely with our AI Solution Specialist and help raise the quality of AI solutions across Sunweb Group, while remaining an active builder yourself.

Contribute to our AI framework and guardrails, promote responsible use of AI and help create visibility around our AI initiatives.

Who you are 

You’re curious, pragmatic and comfortable navigating ambiguity. You combine strong technical judgement with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

You know the difference between an impressive AI demo and a solution that creates measurable business value. You enjoy working independently, bringing different perspectives together and sharing what you learn along the way.

Most importantly, you’re a builder. You enjoy getting hands-on with technology, experimenting, developing prototypes and turning ideas into working solutions. You may have led technical initiatives, defined architecture or coached others, but you haven’t moved away from building things yourself, and you don’t want to.

- A proven track record of delivering complex AI, automation, integration, data or cloud solutions

Wrike’s Backend Reliability (BRE) team is the backbone of our backend infrastructure and the guardian of our uptime. Our mission is to achieve and sustain 99.99% availability while building the tools, components, and safety nets that the entire engineering organization relies on. As a Senior / Staff Backend Engineer on this team, you won’t just close tickets - you’ll architect core reliability solutions that shape how Wrike scales, performs, and recovers from failure.

Your Impact: 

- Design, build, and maintain critical reliability components such as HTTP rate limiters, internal DB schema migration tools, circuit breakers, and distributed Redis-based caching. 

- Troubleshoot complex production issues, optimize PostgreSQL usage, and ensure our distributed systems remain performant and stable under high load.

- Practical experience with containerization and cloud-native environments, including Docker and Kubernetes. 

- Hands-on experience with message brokers such as RabbitMQ or Kafka. 

- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, using critical thinking to question assumptions and validate your own decisions.

You’ll collaborate with other senior engineers who value autonomy, deep technical discussions, and rigorous engineering practices. title: End-of-Line Robotics Engineer
description:
You want to help build Europe’s resilience? You want to protect people and critical infrastructure?

You want to work at the frontier of high-performance autonomous systems? 

Join CDDS and take ownership of our robotic End-of-Line test station, ensuring reliable and thorough validation of every drone. 

CDDS specializes in developing low-collateral kinetic interceptors designed to neutralize malicious drones, including Mavics, FPV racers, and fast fixed wings. Our solutions are built for precision and safety, minimizing risk to surroundings while countering threatening unmanned aerial systems. We work at the cutting edge of counter-drone technology, delivering reliable protection for critical assets and environments.

Tasks 

Your mission 

We are looking for an exceptional End-of-Line Robotics Engineer to take ownership of the automated stations that check every produced drone before it flies. 

These checks span very different fields: propulsion, sensors, calibration, radio links, power and structure. You will be at the heart of our quality control: understand how a drone can fail, find the best way to detect it, and turn that into a reliable validation test on the production line. 

You will work closely with our R&D and production teams, with the autonomy to shape the test architecture and the responsibility to prove it on the line. We are looking for rigour, curiosity and the persistence to follow a defect from its first symptom to a test that catches it every time. 

Core responsibilities 

- Explore different ways to detect each drone defect, choose what to measure and set pass/fail criteria based on data. 

- Design and maintain the test software framework: sequencing tests, driving instruments and robots, logging results and linking every measurement to a drone's serial number. 

- Program handling routines for our collaborative robot and integrate them safely with fixtures and sensors. 

- Move proven tests into the Calibration & Validation room, make them robust for daily use by operators, and improve cycle time, coverage and uptime as volumes grow. 

- Analyse results across the fleet, spot trends and drifts, and report defects to design and production so they are fixed at the source. 

Requirements 

Your profile 

You combine strong engineering and analytical skills with solid software craft. You break complex problems down, reason from data rather than assumptions, and enjoy getting a station working hands-on, not only in code. 

- At least 2 years in test engineering, validation, test automation or production test, ideally on robotic or electromechanical products. 

- Solid robotics fundamentals: modelling system dynamics, choosing sensors and actuators: understanding their trade-offs (noise, bias, bandwidth, cost). 

- Comfortable with reference frames and transforms: relating to IMU, camera and robot or vehicle frames, and how their data is fused together. 

- General knowledge of state estimation and control theory (e.g. Kalman filtering, PID and feedback loops), enough to understand how a drone or robot behaves and why a test result looks the way it does. 

- Strong Python (or similar) for test automation, hardware control and data analysis; comfortable on Linux. And tools such as Docker, Github etc... 

- Experience interfacing software with hardware over common protocols: serial/Ethernet devices, DAQ, sensors. 

- MSc or PhD in robotics, mechatronics, computer science, electronics or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated experience. 

Nice-to-have 

- Classic computer vision and image processing (e.g. OpenCV): camera calibration, feature detection, measuring and inspecting parts from images. 

- Signal processing on test data: filtering, FFT and vibration analysis, anomaly detection on time series. 

- Programming collaborative robots, such as the Fairino FR5 or an equivalent (UR, Doosan, ABB GoFa…), and ROS/ROS 2. 

- Drone or UAV testing: autopilots (PX4/ArduPilot), telemetry and flight log analysis. 

- Deep knowledge of one or more embedded sensor (IMU, magnetometer, barometer, GNSS, cameras), their typical failure modes and calibration methods (e.g. camera–IMU). 

- Test data infrastructure: databases (SQL, time-series), dashboards (e.g. Grafana), traceability systems. 

- Experience in a regulated industry. 

- Reading or writing C/C++ for firmware and embedded tools. 

Benefits

Why CDDS

- Direct impact on a mission-critical technology shaping Europe’s security landscape.

- Fast-moving startup environment with high ownership.

- Work with a highly technical, ambitious, and hands-on team.

- Real-world testing, deployments, and customer demonstrations.

- Attractive compensation.

Details

Environment: High-impact deep-tech startup working on real deployments

title: Junior Data & AI Engineer (Finance)
description:

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

Finance Junior Data & AI Engineer 

Location: Amsterdam, Netherlands | Duration: (12 months)

About the role 

The Finance AI team sits within the Prosus finance organisation and supports the function in reimagining finance through AI. We partner with finance teams to build and deploy impactful AI transformation projects, at scale.

You will join the team as a hands-on Junior Data and AI Engineer. You will help build and maintain the data pipelines that power our AI solutions, and get your first taste of the "intelligence layer" on top: retrieval systems (RAG) and agentic workflows that automate financial analysis. You will work alongside experienced engineers who will guide your work and help you take on more ownership as you grow.

It is a practical role with real projects, real data and direct exposure to finance teams who use what we build.

What you will do 

1. Data pipelines and infrastructure 

- Help build and maintain cloud-based data lake and pipelines using Databricks and following established patterns and team standards.

- Help develop efficient data pipelines for ingesting, processing, and storing large datasets, incorporating best practices for data quality, lineage tracking, and metadata management - specifically optimized for LLM consumption.

- Implement data quality checks, monitor pipeline health and help fix issues as they arise.

2. RAG and agentic workflows 

- RAG & Agentic Systems: Contribute to RAG components (chunking, embeddings, retrieval) and help test improvements such as hybrid search and re-ranking to handle dense financial documents and tables.

- Agentic Workflows: Help build agent workflows using LangGraph and Databricks Agents, with design guidance from senior colleagues.

- Evaluation: Support the evaluation of AI outputs with "LLM-as-a-Judge" frameworks (MLflow) to quantify accuracy, faithfulness, and latency.

- Follow security and privacy guidelines so that AI outputs comply with financial regulations and privacy standards.

- Help maintain and document reusable "Agent templates" that empower Finance business partners to build their own safe AI-driven workflows.

3. Collaboration and enablement 

- Work closely with AI teams and key stakeholders across finance to understand data requirements for AI systems and ensure their smooth deployment.

- Document your work and share what you learn with the team.

- Help finance colleagues use our tools and templates for data tasks.

- Take part in day-to-day workflows with business functions to ensure prompt and high-quality data movement from source systems to production.

- Follow security, privacy and data governance guidelines (including GDPR) in everything you build.

What you bring 

- 1-2 years of experience with a focus on data lake and cloud infrastructure, with an interest in GenAI (RAG, agents or LLM-integrated apps).

- Hands-on exposure to building data pipelines in cloud environments (e.g. AWS, Azure, or GCP). Databricks experience is a plus.

- Good working knowledge of SQL and Python or another programming language to develop custom automation scripts, tables, and solutions. You should be comfortable using AI-native IDEs like Cursor/claude code to accelerate development and refactoring.

- Experience with MCP servers to expose databases and local tools to LLMs, and with REST/GraphQL/FastAPI for building the deterministic "hooks" that AI agents call.

- A structured, methodical approach to problem-solving and the willingness to learn how to troubleshoot.

- Clear communication in English and the confidence to ask questions and work with technical and non-technical colleagues.

- Based in the Netherlands with the right to work here.

Nice to have 

- Knowledge of metadata systems and data lineage tracking tools.

- Exposure to a cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP).

- Familiarity with CI/CD and DevOps practices and infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform, Ansible).

- An affinity for machine learning engineering or an intention to further develop skills in this area.

- Experience with data warehousing concepts and platforms like Snowflake, Google BigQuery.

- A basic understanding of financial concepts and an interest in helping finance colleagues adopt self-service tools.

Why Prosus? 

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing. 

Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page . 

Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment 

We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have.

Want to know more about life at Prosus? Explore our culture and values .

title: Senior Staff Data Scientist, Guest & Host Marketplace AI
description:
Headquarters: Remote

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. 

The Community You Will Join: 

Guest Experience is responsible for Search and Discovery, Merchandising, and end-to-end online software experience worldwide from top-of-funnel discovery through post-booking engagement. We are looking for a talented Data Scientist to join the Guest Data Science team. This tech lead will be at the core of using AI and casual inference to understand user behavior in our app, detect underlying intent, and to build data products needed to provide a compelling and personalized experience of our app. We build products that help guests find the inventory most relevant to them in our marketplace.

The Difference You Will Make: 

As a Senior Staff Data Scientist, you will lead innovation efforts to build methodologies to identify and evaluate the preferences important to every guest, at every step of their online discovery funnel. You will be instrumental in shaping our data strategy to drive guest conversion and regular engagement with the Airbnb platform across our Homes, Experiences and Services business verticals. 

This role emphasizes technical excellence and driving business impact with cutting-edge science. Your role will involve close collaboration with Product to identify in-product optimizations and shape UX design architecture to path how guests navigate from surface-to-surface in our app.

The ideal candidate will demonstrate to be a domain expert with granular user behavior and sequence datasets in a marketplace setting. You will hold a high bar for our customer experience and balance a passion for AI with a strong desire to accurately understand user behavior and business success. Your efforts towards personalized content discovery will help make Airbnb feel tailored for you, maintaining a dialogue with our guests to deeply understand their preferences and reflect that understanding back to them, enabling every guest to easily discover the travel they will love.

A Typical Day: 

- Learn: Develop deep understanding of how guests navigate and re-engage with our app via analysis, research, and by leveraging granular user action and sequence datasets.

- Partner: With product and engineering, drive technical frameworks and science leadership to explore innovative paradigms for detecting revealed preferences and quantifying online frictions.

- Build: Write code for prototypes to detect and quantify taxonomy of guest preferences via iterative development of data frameworks, models and artefacts derived from AI toolkits

- Evaluate: Assess assumptions and efficacy of derived guest preferences via measurement and validating hypotheses linked to online guest action and engagement. Setup experiments and data feedback loops to own a high bar over continuous impact.

- Influence: Regularly present findings and recommendations to leadership audiences to inform strategy and cross-functional deliverables.

- If you’re passionate about going deep into personalized user experiences, we want to hear from you!

Your Expertise: 

- Causal inference expertise with marketplace experience

- Preferred domain experience in search, UX discovery, personalized evidence systems

- Advanced degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Econometrics or related field.

- 9+ years of industry experience with a PhD (or 12+ years with a Masters)

- Strong in communication with XFN partners in product, engineering, and design to enable data-driven product development with a focus on the user experience.

- Expert in at least one programming language for data analysis (Python or R) with familiarity in SQL. Comfort with developing proof-of-concept prototypes. Passionate about AI and possessing a learner’s mindset towards LLMs and dynamic systems.

- Proven ability to succeed in both collaborative and independent work environments

- Demonstrated willingness and track record of engagement with the technical community

Your Location: 

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

Equal Employment Opportunity: 

Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

How We'll Take Care of You: 

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

$224,000 — $280,000 USD

title: Senior Growth Marketer, Web & Experimentation
description:
Our Growth Marketers bring buyers to datasnipper.com through integrated campaigns. You'll turn that traffic into demo requests and pipeline. You'll run A/B tests, personalize the site, work on conversion rate optimization (CRO), and manage the projects that add new functionality to our websites. You'll also bring AI into the website program, building on the AI that already runs our go-to-market.

You'll work from one ranked backlog and report each week on what moved conversion. You'll form hypotheses from data, get them built with our designer and developer, and roll out the winners.

Your closest partners are the Growth Marketers, our Senior Web Experience Designer and Senior Web Developer, and GTM Engineering, which collects intent data from our website.

About DataSnipper 

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals to make those judgements. With Alwin by DataSnipper, our new agentic platform, AI agents now take on end-to-end audit and finance procedures, while every conclusion stays traceable to its source. That frees professionals to focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

We're trusted by Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. Today, more than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on our platform, and in 2025 alone DataSnipper delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to its customers.

Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, we've built a strong foundation for what's next. And as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

Alwin has just launched, demand is growing, and we're expanding into new markets and segments. With a product customers already rely on, there's a huge opportunity to make your mark.

Where the website stands today

Most of our inbound pipeline starts on datasnipper.com . Until now, our Senior Growth Marketer handled CRO on the side, and many people on the Marketing team publish pages, update content individually. In short, very fragmented collaboration.

In an AI-dense market, that work counts for more. Anyone can generate volume now. What's hard, and what earns attention, is staying close to what our customers care about and bringing campaign ideas sharp enough to cut through. That's the work that sets this team apart, and what you'll be part of.

Our tracking needs a cleanup before we can trust test results. Localized landing pages come next: Japan, DACH and France need web experiences in their own language. GTM Engineering already scores visitor intent by page, and we barely use that data on the site. Personalization by segment and market has barely started.

AI already runs parts of our go-to-market. Agents nurture leads, a classifier scores the intent behind every web visit, and we enrich accounts automatically. The website hasn't caught up.

Buyers also find us in new ways. More of them research software through ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google's AI Overviews before they ever reach our site.

The web team has a dedicated designer and developer. This role decides what we test next and reports what worked.

What you'll be doing

Run the experimentation program

- Build the testing roadmap for datasnipper.com and the localized sites, from hypothesis to rollout.

- Set the website's testing rules: minimum sample size, test duration, and when to call or stop a test.

- Keep a learning log that Growth, Sales and Product Marketing check before they propose a test.

- Report results in pipeline terms: demo requests, demo-to-SQL rate and pipeline per session.

Improve conversion where buyers decide

- Optimize the demo request flow and the pricing, product and campaign pages.

- Map the funnel from first visit to SQL in GA4 and HubSpot, find where buyers drop off, and fix it.

- Work with the Growth Marketers to match each campaign landing page to its ad, audience and market.

Personalize the site

- Tailor content, proof points and CTAs by vertical, market and buying stage.

- Use intent and enrichment data from GTM Engineering to decide who sees what.

- Test each localized site as it launches, to the same standard as the English site.

Build AI into the web program

- Use the intent and enrichment data we already collect to build pages that adapt to each visitor.

- Use AI to generate and localize test variants, so we test more ideas each month.

- Automate test QA, result analysis and weekly reporting, with a person signing off on the results.

- Prototype new AI experiences for buyers, such as an assistant that answers product and pricing questions.

Manage web projects

- Scope new website functionality, write the brief, and run delivery with our designer and developer.

- Turn requests from Product Marketing, Sales, Partnerships and Growth into a ranked backlog, and use data to decide what waits.

- Run QA and launch, then measure each project's result.

Keep the site findable and measurable

- Protect organic search and AI visibility in every test and launch: canonicals, page speed, schema markup and crawl access.

- Track traffic and demo requests referred by AI assistants, and test pages for buyers who arrive that way.

- Maintain website tracking with Marketing Operations in Google Tag Manager, GA4 and HubSpot.

- Build the weekly web performance view the team works from.

What we’re looking for

- 5+ years in CRO, web optimization or growth marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS. You've run an A/B testing program and can walk us through tests that won and tests that lost.

- Data fluency. You know when to trust a test result, and when sample size, novelty or segment noise undermine it. You pull your own numbers from GA4 and HubSpot.

- Structure. You run a backlog, write briefs a developer can build from, and keep several projects moving. You tell stakeholders each week what ships.

- Collaboration. You get work done through a designer, a developer and stakeholders who all want space on the website. You involve them before you set a hypothesis, and use data to settle priority disputes.

- AI builder. You’ve shipped something with AI that changed how a team works: an agent, an automated workflow, or a tool other people use. Bring the example and what broke first.

- Commercial focus. You judge tests on the pipeline they create.

Tools you'll work with (willingness to ramp & learn matters more than a complete checklist):

- Creative: Figma, Canva

- Website: Framer, Contentstack

- Analytics: HubSpot, Looker Studio, Supermetrics, Fibbler, Snowflake

- CRM and marketing automation: HubSpot

- Experimentation and personalization: Optimizely

- Behavior analytics: heatmaps and session recordings

- Project management and handoff: Linear, Figma

- AI: Claude Enterprise (Projects, Skills and MCP integrations), ChatGPT, and build tools such as Lovable or n8n

Bonus: hands-on technical SEO and a view on how AI search changes the way buyers find B2B software. SQL, or enough HTML, CSS and JavaScript to set up a test yourself.

Recruitment Process 

- Recruiter Screen (30 minutes, online)

- Hiring Manager Interview (30 minutes, online)

- Assessment Interview (1 hour, on-site)

- Final Interview (30 minutes, online)

What matters to us is what you can bring to the role, the team, and DataSnipper. 🚀
