title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
At Gigaton, we’re on a mission to cut gigatonnes of carbon emissions from the world’s biggest emitting industries (like cement, steel and glass), by building autonomous AI control and optimisation systems that learn and leverage the physics of manufacturing. Our products run heavy industrial plants more efficiently, more stably, and with lower emissions in real time - laying the foundation for the next industrial revolution.

We are a team of scientists, engineers, builders, and operators who love hard problems, have high standards, and want to make change happen in the physical world. We care about deep tech, but we care even more about whether it delivers cost and carbon impact in a live plant, with real people, under real constraints.

With Gigaton, you’ll solve really tough problems in places few people ever get close to, and build something that actually helps the planet. Are you up for the challenge?

About the role 

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Platform team and help us build reliable software for a complex, real-world AI product.

The Platform team works across a broad range of problems at Gigaton, from CI/CD for our monorepo and networking and data integration with on-premise plant systems, to hardening our IoT OS image and building customer-facing software around our control systems.

The work is currently split across two squads: 

- Enablement, focused on helping engineers move faster.

- Product, focused on supporting our control software.

Whichever squad you join, you’ll work across technically challenging problems with plenty of scope to learn, contribute and shape how we build software.

Your main responsibilities 

- Write reliable, well-tested software in Python and Terraform.

- Monitor, support and improve software running in production.

- Mentor less experienced engineers and help them develop their craft.

- Identify, articulate and drive architectural improvements.

- Bring strong software engineering practices to code developed across the wider engineering and ML teams.

- Contribute to improving the quality, maintainability and reliability of our systems.

Bonus experience 

You don’t need all of these, but experience in any of the following would be useful:

- Control engineering, machine learning or MLOps.

- AWS IoT, Greengrass or Mender for managing device fleets.

- Working across multiple cloud environments, such as AWS, GCP or Azure.

- Managing CI/CD environments using GitHub Actions.

- Building production artefacts using tools such as Docker.

- Functional programming languages such as Haskell, F# or Elm.

- Building or working with more complex AI-enabled workflows beyond simple prompting.

You’ll excel if you are 

- Excited by complex technical domains and enjoy getting to grips with unfamiliar systems.

- Highly collaborative and comfortable working across software, ML and other disciplines.

- Familiar with practices such as testing, pairing, mobbing and iterative software development.

- Pragmatic about engineering trade-offs and know when good enough now is better than perfect later.

- Comfortable working with ambiguity and evolving requirements.

- Able to improve existing systems, not just build new ones from scratch.

- Happy to take ownership of problems and follow them through into production.

💡 You are not expected to check every box, and we’d love to hear from you even if your experience isn’t an exact match. 

We’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change. Our people come from different countries, cultures and experiences, and we think that’s one of our biggest strengths.

We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels safe, respected and celebrated. No matter your background, if you’re excited by what we do, we want to hear from you.

The interview process 

Our interview process is designed to help us understand your experience, how you think and how you work with others, while giving you plenty of opportunity to get to know Gigaton too.

1. Talent Partner conversation 

You’ll start with a conversation with our Talent Partner. We’ll talk through your background, what you’re looking for and what interests you about Gigaton.

We’ll also give you more context on the role, the team and the interview process, and answer any initial questions you have.

2. Hiring Manager interview 

Next, you’ll meet the hiring manager for a deeper conversation about your experience and some of the technical problems you’ve worked on.

We’ll explore the work you’ve owned, the decisions you’ve made, how you approach engineering trade-offs and whether the role feels like a strong match on both sides.

3a. Pair Programming - remote session 

You’ll work with one of our engineers on a small technical exercise using Python and Terraform.

We’re not assessing memorised syntax or speed under pressure. We’re interested in how you reason, collaborate, use tests to guide your work, learn from documentation or tools, and communicate while solving an unfamiliar problem.

3b. Technical Onsite 

This technical stage takes place in our London office and consists of one session.

System design 

You’ll walk us through a real system you’ve worked on and had meaningful influence over.

We’ll ask about the problem, constraints, operational characteristics, design decisions, trade-offs and how the system evolved over time.

This isn’t a formal presentation. You’ll introduce the system for around 10–15 minutes, then we’ll explore it together in more depth.

4. Operating Principles interview 

We’ll discuss examples from your past experience that relate to how we work at Gigaton:

- Concrete Honesty

- Autonomous Ownership

- Go Gig or Go Home

- Cement It with Fun and Kindness

We’re interested in specific examples of how you’ve demonstrated these behaviours in practice rather than abstract culture-fit questions.

5. CEO conversation 

Finally, you’ll meet Josh, our CEO.

This is a chance to talk more broadly about Gigaton, our mission, where the company is heading and whether this feels like the right move for both sides.

We believe hiring is a two-way process. Just as we’ll conduct reference checks before making a final offer, we encourage you to reference-check us too by speaking with team members you haven’t yet met.

Once interviews are complete, we’ll move quickly to a decision, and we’re always happy to provide feedback at any stage.

In return for your hard work, we’ll give you 

📈 Equity in the company: When we win, you win. You’ll get share options, so you’re part of our journey from the inside.

🕰️ Flexible working We trust you to know how and when you work best and to work that out with your team.

🌴 30 days of holiday (plus bank holidays). Rest is productive. Take the time you need to recharge

🪙 A generous pension scheme. We’re planning for the future in more ways than one.

Our Operating Principles 

↗️ Go Gig or Go Home : High Bar, All In. What we do matters to humanity, to our customers and to each other. We hold ourselves to an extraordinarily high bar and bring the urgency this mission requires.

🏭 Concrete Honesty : Be honest. As concrete forms the foundation of our world, genuine honesty and transparency are the bedrock of our culture.

🦾 Autonomous Ownership : High agency, high ownership. We build systems that take control and make things better. We do the same: see it, own it, drive it.

😄 Cement it with Kindness & Fun : Have fun, be kind. We're here to extend Earth's life, but ours is still limited. We want to enjoy the ride. To see these in full, go to Gigaton’s Operating Principles Notion page.

Compensation: £60K – £105K • Multiple Ranges

- Mid Level • £60K – £85K

title: Software Engineer, Agent
description:
About us 

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Sierra was co-founded by Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor who first met while working together at Google over 20 years ago. Bret currently serves as Chairman of the Board of Open AI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce and CTO of Facebook. Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs.

What you’ll do 

- Design and deliver production-grade AI agents : You'll build and ship highly performant, reliable, and intuitive AI agents that are central, mission-critical and drive revenue directly to Sierra's growth. These aren't prototypes—they are powerful, scalable systems running in production environments across industries like finance, healthcare, and commerce.

- Drive the Agent Development Life Cycle (ADLC) : You'll have complete ownership and autonomy from initial pilot through deployment and continuous iteration. You'll be responsible for building, tuning, and evolving AI agents in production environments, defining the standard for ADLC best practices along the way.

- Partner with large enterprises and cutting-edge startups: You’ll work directly with leaders at some of the world’s largest enterprises to understand their most pressing business challenges, and build AI agents that transform how they operate at scale. You'll also partner with the most cutting-edge startups, embedding AI agents across their entire business stack to drive innovation and efficiency.

- Build the future of the platform: Your direct work with customers will guide the evolution of Sierra's core platform. You'll surface unmet needs, prototype new tools and features, and collaborate with research, product, and platform to shape the future of AI agent development and Sierra's product.

Example projects 

These are some examples of projects that engineers on our team have worked on recently:

- Design and build AI agents for large telecommunications and media companies that consistently outperform human agents in managing subscription churn

- Develop and refine AI agents capable of navigating complex customer interactions, like troubleshooting a broken device and personalising product recommendations

- Create generalisable AI agent frameworks tailored for industry-specific use cases. See some examples in our financial services blog !

- Facilitate design partnerships for new product initiatives, such as new agent architectures, self-service capabilities, and generative agent development

- Experiment with the latest voice models and figure out how to integrate them at scale to enterprise-grade customers

What you'll bring 

- Experience building and scaling end-to-end production systems

- Strong technical problem-solving skills, especially in fast-changing, ambiguous environments

- A builder and tinkerer’s mindset with high agency - you find creative ways to overcome obstacles and ship

- Comfort working directly with customers to understand their needs and solve real-world problems

- Excellent communication skills - clear, direct, and persuasive across technical and non-technical audiences

Even better... 

- Experience building or deploying AI/LLM systems in production

- Have been a founder or founding engineer - you know what it means to balance craft, ownership, and speed

- Familiarity with tools that power today's AI agents: eval frameworks, agent tooling, RAG pipelines, and prompt engineering

- Prior experience with React, TypeScript, and/or Go

- Previous roles where you interfaced with customers or led technical projects with external stakeholders

Our values 

- Trust: We do the right thing, even when no one is looking, and even when it’s hard. When we screw up, we take accountability, fully and completely. We act in such a way that if all of our actions were completely visible to our customers, we would be proud.

- Customer Obsession: Our entire business is designed to ensure every agent built on Sierra succeeds, and that we are accountable to our customers and their success. We do whatever it takes to make our customers successful, and we go the extra mile in how we show up as a partner with unreasonable hospitality.

- Craftsmanship: A great company is the aggregation of thousands of things done well. As they say, “how you do anything is how you do everything”. Most important is craftsmanship in building agents that are so great that people thank them at the end of a call. That’s the standard.

- Intensity: We operate with urgency, and we want to win. We are never complacent. We fight to win every deal, big or small, using the full force of the company. And when we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

- Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We work hard, and turn on the afterburners when needed. But we pick up our parents at the airport when they’re visiting from out of town. We go to our kids’ events. And we show up for one another, in moments of celebration and hardship.

What we offer 

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

- Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

- Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

- Life insurance and disability benefits

- Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

- Parental leave

- Fertility and family building benefits

- Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized when working onsite

- Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

- Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region and employment type, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

Be you, with us 

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. We encourage you to apply through the link on this page even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description.

Sierra is a proud equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws, including veteran status and disability status. Hiring decisions are made by people, based on merit. If you need a reasonable accommodation for a disability, a religious practice, pregnancy or any related condition at any point in the application or interview process, contact us at ----- Requests are handled confidentially and do not affect your candidacy.

We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with applicable fair chance laws.

title: Agent Engineer - US Remote
description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

The AI Engineering Team is chartered with enabling next-generation AI applications , with a special focus on Large Language Models (LLMs) and agentic systems . Our mission is to build robust pipelines, high-performance infrastructure, and operational tooling that allow AI systems to be deployed with speed, safety, and scale .

We manage petabyte-scale pipelines, serve models with millisecond-level latency, and provide the observability and governance needed to make AI production-ready. We’re also deeply involved in evaluating and integrating cutting-edge tools in the LLM and agent space — including open-source stacks, vector databases, evaluation frameworks, and orchestration tools that unlock TRM’s ability to innovate faster than the market.

The impact you will have: 

- 
Architect and implement a robust agentic framework that supports tool use, context retrieval, memory, and planning

- 
Build intelligent, modular agents that automate investigative tasks and augment analyst decision-making

- 
Extend and scale our LLM infrastructure (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic, local models), including prompt engineering, RAG, and evaluation loops

- 
Design safe, observable, and auditable agent behaviors — ensuring reliability in high-sensitivity environments

- 
Evaluate performance across metrics like reasoning, latency, success rate, and hallucination, and iterate based on user feedback and system telemetry

- 
Contribute to a culture of high ownership, rapid experimentation, and ethical AI deployment

What we’re looking for: 

- 
Strong engineering background with deep experience in backend or systems work (Python preferred)

- 
Hands-on experience building with LLMs, agents, and tooling frameworks (LangChain, semantic caches, vector DBs, etc.)

- 
Comfort working with agentic pipelines and optimizing information flow into AI systems

- 
Thoughtful approach to system design, with an eye for safety, scalability, and explainability

- 
High product empathy - you care about how agents impact real users (analysts) and optimize accordingly

- 
Bias toward experimentation and iteration - you’re excited to try, learn, and ship fast

- 
Previous experience with knowledge graphs, task orchestration, or AI safety a plus

About the Team: 

- 
The AI Engineering team operates with a high level of collaboration and interdependence, fostering an inclusive culture where connections extend beyond work. We value diverse personalities and seek someone who is both results-driven and sociable, with strong communication, leadership, and teamwork skills, along with a positive, solutions-oriented mindset.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position: 

- 
Rapid Issue Resolution. TRM Engineers identify and resolve critical onsite issues in minutes to hours, not weeks. We create virtual war rooms, implement fixes, and share lessons with both customer stakeholders and internal teams within 48 hours.

- 
Navigating Bureaucracy. We anticipate and address procedural hurdles, build trust with key stakeholders, and find alternative pathways to approvals. This keeps projects moving even in complex environments.

- 
Efficient Knowledge Transfer. Engineers document and share updates in real time, ensuring the entire team—onsite and remote—has full visibility into plans, blockers, and resolutions. Knowledge sharing sessions and clear documentation reduce friction and accelerate delivery.

About TRM's Engineering Levels: 

Engineer: Responsible for helping to define project milestones and executing small decision decisions independently with the appropriate tradeoffs between simplicity, readability, and performance. Provides mentorship to junior engineers, and enhances operational excellence through tech debt reduction and knowledge sharing.

Senior Engineer: Successfully designs and documents system improvements and features for an OKR/project from the ground up. Consistently delivers efficient and reusable systems, optimizes team throughput with appropriate tradeoffs, mentors team members, and enhances cross-team collaboration through documentation and knowledge sharing.

Staff Engineer: Drives scoping and execution of one or more OKRs/projects that impact multiple teams. Partners with stakeholders to set the team vision and technical roadmaps for one or more products. Is a role model and mentor to the entire engineering organization. Ensures system health and quality with operational reviews, testing strategies, and monitoring rigor.

The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role: 

- 
Individual pay is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. The compensation details listed in this posting reflect the US base salary only.

- 
The estimated base salary range for this role is $200,000 - $270,000

- 
Additionally, this role may be eligible to participate in TRM’s equity plan.

- 
Please note – we factor in the different costs for geographies outside the United States.

Application Instructions 

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM 

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

- 
Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

- 
Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

- 
First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

- 
Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

- 
References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

- 
Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

- 
Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM 

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

- 
Accelerate repeatable workflows

- 
Structure and solve problems

- 
Improve output quality

- 
Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM 

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

- 
Priorities and targets to change quickly

- 
Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

- 
A high level of personal ownership and accountability

- 
Close collaboration across teams and functions

- 
Frequent, high-touch communication

- 
Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

- 
A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. 

Leadership Principles 

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

- 
Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

- 
Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

- 
Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission 

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore. 

Privacy Policy and Additional Information 

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy .

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com .

title: Staff Software Engineer - Revenue Intelligence
description:

At Cloudbeds , we're not just building software, we're transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. Since our founding in 2012, we've continually been recognized for excellence, most recently earning top honors at the 2026 HotelTechAwards for Best Hotel Management Software and landing on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again, but we're just getting started.

Location: Remote (Europe)

What Makes Us Unique: 

At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From independent properties to hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. Since our founding in 2012, we've become the World's Best Hotel PMS Solutions Provider and landed on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again in 2024 – but we're just getting started. 

How You'll Make an Impact: 

As a Staff Software Engineer in Revenue Intelligence, you will shape the technical direction of systems that help hospitality businesses understand demand, identify revenue opportunities, and make better pricing and commercial decisions. You will work across customer-facing applications, backend services, data pipelines, analytical stores, recommendation workflows, and cloud infrastructure. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will solve complex engineering problems directly while establishing architecture, improving reliability and security, reducing systemic technical debt, and aligning multiple teams around durable technical decisions. Your impact will extend beyond individual features to the quality, scalability, operability, and long-term evolution of the Revenue Intelligence platform.

Our Revenue Intelligence Team: 

The Revenue Intelligence team builds products and platforms that turn hospitality data into practical decisions for hoteliers, including pricing recommendations, demand insights, reporting, automation, and commercial opportunities. Our systems span frontend experiences, APIs, distributed services, data processing, machine-learning workflows, and production infrastructure. We value pragmatic engineering, strong ownership, evidence-based decisions, and technical leaders who raise the effectiveness of the people and systems around them.

What You Bring to the Team: 

- Set and evolve the technical strategy for RMS, translating product and business goals into coherent architecture and executable engineering plans

- Lead the design and delivery of complex capabilities across customer-facing web applications, backend APIs, event-driven services, data pipelines, analytical storage, and recommendation workflows

- Identify and resolve systemic risks in scalability, reliability, security, data quality, observability, and operability before they become recurring customer or engineering problems

- Drive modernization of legacy systems and infrastructure through incremental, well-reasoned migrations that preserve delivery momentum and production stability

- Partner with Product, Data Science, Infrastructure, Security, and engineering leaders to define boundaries, contracts, ownership, and long-term platform direction

- Own the codebase through implementation, technical spikes, design reviews, debugging, incident response, and the most consequential or ambiguous engineering work

- Raise the technical effectiveness of the wider organization through mentoring, architecture guidance, engineering standards, documentation, and constructive challenge

What Sets You Up for Success: 

- 10+ years of software engineering experience, including significant technical leadership across complex production systems

- Deep hands-on expertise with backend and data engineering technologies. Our stack includes .NET/C#, Python, PostgreSQL, Redshift, Kafka/Debezium, Airflow, gRPC, AWS (EKS, S3, SQS, Batch), Terraform, Helm/Argo CD and Datadog, or equivalent experience

- Strong architecture and distributed-systems fundamentals, including API design, event-driven workflows, CDC and streaming, data archiving, and batch compute

- Deep PostgreSQL experience at scale, including performance tuning, partitioning, and large online migrations

- A track record of rebuilding production data syncs and pipelines incrementally, keeping them idempotent, reconciled, and running throughout

- Strong cloud and platform engineering experience across AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD, observability, and secure production operations

- A demonstrated ability to lead through influence, create alignment across teams, communicate complex tradeoffs clearly, and drive decisions from ambiguity to execution

- A strong record of improving engineering quality through testing strategy, operational readiness, incident learning, security, documentation, and sustainable technical standards

- Product judgment and customer empathy, with the ability to connect technical investments to measurable outcomes for hoteliers and the business

- Business-level English fluency and experience collaborating effectively in a remote, globally distributed organization

LE SUJET DE STAGE 

Dans un environnement retail en constante évolution, nos équipes en magasin ont besoin d'outils prédictifs performants pour anticiper leur activité et adapter leur organisation au quotidien. Aujourd'hui, l'optimisation des plannings, la prévision d'affluence et l'anticipation de la charge de travail représentent des défis majeurs d'échelle et de précision.

Au sein de nos équipes Data & IA, ton objectif sera de participer à l'amélioration, à l'évaluation et au passage à l'échelle de nos modèles de prévision déjà en production, en explorant notamment l'apport des nouveaux modèles de fondation temporels et tabulaires. 

L'enjeu : réaliser un état de l'art des solutions émergentes, adapter ces modèles à nos problématiques réelles complexes et structurer un framework de benchmark robuste pour valider scientifiquement les meilleures approches.

TES RESPONSABILITÉS 

Tu interviendras sur l'ensemble de la chaîne de valeur du projet, de la recherche appliquée jusqu'à la mise en production :

- Veille et état de l'art scientifique : Explorer et évaluer les nouvelles approches de modèles de fondation pour séries temporelles et données tabulaires (TSFM / TabFM).

- Spécialisation et adaptation : Entraîner, spécialiser (fine-tuning) et adapter ces modèles de fondation aux contraintes opérationnelles réelles du retail.

- Framework de benchmark et d'évaluation : Concevoir un cadre de test standardisé et structurer des jeux de données réels pour comparer objectivement les performances des différents modèles.

- Optimisation des modèles prédictifs : Participer à l'amélioration de nos modèles prédictifs actuellement en production.

- Collaboration et valorisation : Restituer tes travaux de manière claire et évaluer, selon les résultats et tes appétences, l'opportunité d'une publication scientifique ou technique.

Le périmètre technique : 

- Python, SQL

- PyTorch ou TensorFlow, Hugging Face, benchmarks de modèles de fondation (ex. GIFT-Eval, TIME, fev-bench)

- Databricks, Spark, dbt

- Airflow (Astronomer), AWS (S3, ECR, ...)

- Jupyter, Git, Docker

- Formation : Tu es étudiant(e) en dernière année d'école d'ingénieur ou en Master 2 spécialisé en Mathématiques Appliquées, Data Science, Intelligence Artificielle, Informatique ou équivalent, à la recherche d'un stage de fin d'études de 6 mois .

- Socle technique : Tu maîtrises Python, SQL et Git, et tu possèdes de solides bases en statistiques, Machine Learning et Deep Learning. 

- Communication : Tu as d' excellentes compétences interpersonnelles, analytiques et de présentation, avec la capacité de vulgariser des concepts techniques complexes de manière simple pour des équipes métiers.

- État d'esprit : Tu aimes explorer et résoudre des problèmes, clarifier proactivement les besoins, travailler en autonomie et prendre des responsabilités lorsque cela est nécessaire.

- Culture : Tu es sensible à l'impact de la pratique du sport et tu as envie de rejoindre une entreprise à impact positif ( #Tech4Good ).

- Cerise sur le gâteau : Tu as déjà travaillé sur des problématiques liées au retail ou manipulé des datasets complexes de séries temporelles en environnement réel.

CE QUE NOUS OFFRONS 

- Un environnement de travail moderne dans nos bureaux Decathlon Digital à Paris

- La possibilité d’innover et d’avoir de l’impact grâce à la data et à la technologie

- Liberté de choix de l'outil de travail (Mac, Windows)

- Une équipe projet locale connectée à un réseau international

- Montée en compétences et mentorat (diversité de projets, technologies de pointe, certifications, événements)

- Formations internes et externes

- Gratification de stage et possibilité de pré-embauche selon opportunités

DECATHLON DIGITAL 

Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d'offrir des expériences sportives inédites. C'est précisément notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits.

Changeons la donne pour de bon. Notre passion du sport nous guide et nous voulons qu’elle perdure. Rejoins l’équipe et façonnons le futur du sport.

title: Talent Acquisition Science - EMEA
description:
About Mistral 

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role 

As a Science & Research Talent Acquisition Specialist, you will own the hiring of the researchers and scientists who push our frontier models forward. You will partner closely with our Science leadership and research leads to find, engage, and secure exceptional talent: research scientists and research engineers.

You will also hire for Mistral Discovery, our initiative pushing AI development in real-world industries, bringing scientific talent to the problems where AI can have the greatest practical impact.

This is one of the most competitive talent markets in the world. You will be competing with the best-funded labs and big tech for a small pool of people, many of whom are not looking for a job. As an early member of the team, you will shape how we recruit scientists at Mistral and build the foundations to scale it.

What You Will Do 

- Source and engage world-class researchers through direct outreach, academic networks, publications, open-source contributions, and the international conference circuit (e.g. NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR).

- Build a deep understanding of our research areas and the wider AI research landscape, so you can hold credible conversations with scientists about their work and our research direction.

- Partner with research leads and hiring managers to define role profiles, calibrate seniority, and align on what "exceptional" looks like for each research position.

- Design and run interview processes adapted to research hiring, including research talks, paper discussions, technical deep dives, and applied problem-solving, while keeping them rigorous and respectful of candidates' time.

- Own the candidate journey from first contact to signed offer, with particular care for passive candidates, senior researchers, and academics weighing a move from a lab or university.

- Build pipelines early: PhD and postdoc talent, research interns and residents, and relationships with leading universities, labs, and research communities.

- Navigate the complexity of international research hiring, including relocation, work authorization, and offer structure, in coordination with People Ops and Legal.

- Advise on compensation, equity, and research-specific considerations (publication policy, research freedom, compute access) to craft compelling, competitive offers.

- Use data to track pipeline health, conversion, time-to-hire, and market trends, and use those insights to refine our approach.

- Build scalable systems, documentation, and best practices to support rapid growth in the research organization.

- Act as an ambassador for Mistral's research culture, internally and externally.

- Embrace hybrid work, with regular onsite collaboration in Paris to strengthen team connections.

What We're Looking For 

- Proven experience: 3+ years in recruiting in tech, ideally with experience in AI/ML, deep tech, or research-intensive environments.

- Research hiring expertise: A track record of closing research scientists, research engineers, or PhD-level candidates in competitive markets, and the ability to evaluate profiles beyond keywords (publication record, research impact, trajectory).

- Scientific fluency: Solid understanding of the AI/ML research landscape and the curiosity to keep learning. You can discuss a candidate's work with them and with our researchers.

- Market savvy: Ability to own and execute searches independently in highly competitive talent landscapes, including passive and senior candidates.

- Stakeholder influence: Ability to advise and align research leaders and senior scientists with credibility and diplomacy.

- Data-driven mindset: Skilled at analyzing metrics to solve problems and optimize recruitment processes.

- Global perspective: Experience with international hiring (including relocation and visa considerations) and fluent English communication. French is a plus.

- Hands-on execution: Capable of balancing strategy with operational excellence, staying organized and disciplined.

- Tool proficiency: Familiarity with modern ATS (e.g. Ashby), LinkedIn search, scheduling (e.g. Modernloop), and AI-driven productivity tools is a plus. Experience sourcing via Google Scholar, arXiv, GitHub, or Semantic Scholar is a strong plus.

Who You Are 

These aren't buzzwords. They reflect what we look for in the people we hire, and what we have seen make the difference in this role.

- Curious by nature. You learn constantly, and you dig into new research areas, tools and ways of working because you want to, not because you have to.

- At home in pace and ambiguity. You thrive when things move fast and the path isn't clear, and you turn chaos into a clean state.

- A proactive doer. You are highly efficient, you don't wait to be asked, and you turn ideas into real-life results.

- A builder of better recruitment. You enjoy partnering with the HRBP team to constantly improve how we recruit.

What We Offer 

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page .

title: Senior Software Engineer I
description:
Company Description 

We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. 

We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. 

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. 

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. 

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. 

Job Description 

Global payments are complex and ever-evolving. At Checkout our software engineers develop the next-generation payments technologies that enable our Merchants to boost their acceptance rates, cut processing costs, fight fraud, and create cutting edge technology that enables extraordinary customer experiences.

We're looking for Senior Software engineers who bring fresh ideas, have a curious nature and are passionate about working in an Engineering environment which focuses on building products to achieve the company's strategic goals. You’ll get to work with teams from across Checkout.com ’s portfolio of products and services who all have a real customer first philosophy.

As a Senior Software engineer, you will lead and drive specific projects critical to Checkout's needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display exceptional leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward. With your technical expertise you will lead project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.

What are we looking for: 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field

- Proficiency in C# .NET, Java, or Go, with a strong understanding of software development principles in either a backend or full stack environment.

- Great communication skills and ability to interact effectively with a wide range of stakeholders

- Experience working in agile environments and delivering high-quality code within tight deadlines

- Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently as well as part of a team

- Someone who is AI proficient or AI curious, you will be hungry to embrace what the latest technology has to offer to enhance yours and your teams productivity

- Payments or financial knowledge is a plus, but not a necessity

How you’ll make an impact: 

- Be part of, and collaborate with, cross-functional teams including product management, across a large engineering community.

- Define and design loosely coupled, scalable systems in a wider microservices using industry best practices.

- Stay up-to-date, use, and spread knowledge of the latest technologies used by Checkout.

- Write clean, maintainable, extendable and testable code on some of Checkout’s most impactful systems.

- Build, own and operate your systems to the highest levels of resilience and service.

- Mentor junior team members and assist in their technical development

Additional Information 

Bring all of you to work 

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com 

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

title: Senior Security Engineer, AI & Application Security
description:
We are looking for a seasoned Senior Security Engineer, focused on AI & Application Security, to join our Platform team in Amsterdam. Working in a bootstrapped and profitable scaleup, you'll take a proactive, hands-on, senior role securing our agentic AI products, owning an emerging and fast-growing area of security engineering, the risks that come specifically from building with LLMs and autonomous agents, while helping raise the bar on our broader application security practices.

Why DataSnipper? 

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust. 

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers . Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way. 

What You Will Do

- Own AI-specific security as a discipline at DataSnipper: identify, assess, and mitigate the risks unique to LLM-based and agentic systems across our products and platform.

- Translate security policies and risk requirements into concrete technical controls, standards, and guardrails, in partnership with Legal and technical teams.

- Build a proactive AI security practice grounded in frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, the broader OWASP GenAI Security Project (including agentic security), MITRE ATLAS, and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and adapt them to how we build.

- Threat model our agentic features and pipelines, covering prompt injection, sensitive information disclosure, data and model poisoning, insecure output handling, excessive agency, supply-chain risk, and unsafe tool and API use.

- Red team our AI systems, probing models, prompts, agents, and integrations for weaknesses before attackers do, and turn findings into concrete fixes and guardrails.

- Design and help implement guardrails, input/output validation, sandboxing, least-privilege tool access, and monitoring for AI and agent behavior.

- Embed security into how we build AI, shifting security left through secure-by-design guidance, secure SDLC practices, and design and code reviews for AI features.

- Partner with product and engineering teams to make secure AI the default, providing patterns, tooling, and guidance rather than after-the-fact gatekeeping.

- Strengthen our overall security engineering posture alongside the SRE team, contributing to our SOC 2 and compliance efforts (e.g. via Vanta), CI/CD security gates, and the principle that vulnerable code cannot get deployed.

- Own our vulnerability management process: identify and prioritize vulnerabilities based on risk, drive remediation across engineering and platform teams, track findings to closure, and fix recurring findings at the root.

- Strengthen identity and access management, secrets management, and encryption across our products and platform, including the credentials and access that agents and AI integrations depend on.

- Establish detection, logging, and incident response practices for AI-specific threats, and help the team respond when they occur.

- Stay ahead of a rapidly evolving threat landscape and continuously raise the bar for how we secure AI.

- Promote secure development practices through developer guidance and trainings, awareness initiatives, and collaboration with engineering teams.

What You Bring

- Minimum 5 years of experience in security engineering, application security, or a closely related field, with a track record of owning security work end to end in production.

- Strong grounding in application and cloud security fundamentals: threat modeling, secure design, common vulnerability classes, and secure SDLC practices.

- Hands-on experience with SAST, DAST, SCA, API Security, Threat Modeling and Vulnerability Management.

- Hands-on experience with identity and access management, secrets management, and encryption implementations.

- Demonstrated interest and hands-on experience in AI/LLM security, whether through professional work, research, red teaming, CTFs, or personal projects, and familiarity with frameworks like the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications or MITRE ATLAS.

- Solid understanding of how LLM-based and agentic systems work in practice, including prompts, tool/function calling, retrieval, and agent orchestration, and where they break.

- Proficiency in a scripting or programming language (Python preferred) to build tooling, automate checks, and prototype mitigations.

- Experience securing cloud-native systems, ideally on Azure, including CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub) and infrastructure-as-code.

- A proactive, builder mindset; you prevent problems by shipping guardrails and enabling teams, not just by finding issues.

- Strong communication skills; able to explain AI-specific risks and tradeoffs to engineers, product managers, and leadership.

- Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-moving scale-up, set technical direction, influence without authority, and mentor other engineers while defining a practice that doesn't yet have a playbook.

Preferred Qualifications

- Hands-on experience red teaming or pentesting AI/LLM systems.

- Familiarity with the OWASP GenAI Security Project's agentic security work and emerging standards for securing autonomous agents.

- Experience with AI security tooling such as guardrail frameworks, LLM firewalls, prompt-injection scanners, or AI red-teaming tools.

- Experience implementing security controls in production agentic systems, including sandboxing, least-privilege tool access, and runtime monitoring.

- Familiarity with compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001) and tools like Vanta.

- Experience with observability and monitoring tooling (e.g. Grafana).

- Relevant security certifications (e.g. OSCP, GIAC, or AI-security-specific credentials).

- Experience in fintech, audit technology, or other regulated, trust-sensitive domains.

- Familiarity with responsible AI, model governance, or AI safety concepts.

What We Offer: 

- Be part of one of the fastest-growing, profitable unicorn scale-ups in the Netherlands with a global impact

- Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights) to share the company's success and growth

- Pension plan with a 6% contribution on top of your base salary

- 28 vacation days per year (full-time) to support your work-life balance

- Hybrid work model with at least 3 days onsite in our dynamic Amsterdam office

- Daily, freshly prepared lunches by our in-house chef to keep you energized

- NS business card for easy commuting to the office if applicable

- Access to continuous learning and development initiatives to grow your skills

- Engage with a vibrant international team spread across five global offices

- Company-wide events like DataSnipper GO, where global teams come together

- Access to a mental health and wellness platform supporting your wellbeing

Recruitment Process 

- Recruitment Screen (30 minutes, online)

- Hiring Manager Interview (30 minutes, online)

- Assessment Interview (60 minutes, on-site)

- Final Interview (30 minutes, online)

At DataSnipper, we believe great ideas come from different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and providing every candidate with a fair and equitable hiring experience. 

Our hiring decisions are merit-based and grounded in the skills, experience, potential, and capabilities relevant to the role. 

We welcome applicants regardless of age, race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes you, you. 

What matters to us is what you can bring to the role, the team, and DataSnipper. 🚀

title: Senior Kubernetes Platform Engineer
description:
AI FactoryOS Operations 

AI FactoryOS is Firmus' proprietary operating system for the AI Factory. It governs GPU telemetry, cooling, power and grid interaction as one integrated layer, so that every Firmus site can be optimised and monitored as a single system. 

AI FactoryOS Operations runs that platform in production and owns the 24/7 reliability of AI FactoryOS, Firmus AI Cloud and the platforms built on them, together with the service levels the estate is measured against. 

The remit is an engineering one. The function builds the guarded automation, remediation and operational tooling that turn manual response into a software-defined capability. It also builds the shared services the estate's own operation depends on, and runs them. Operating the estate every day is what shows how the platform behaves under real load and under failure, and the function works with the engineering teams that build it to turn what it finds into permanent fixes and design improvements. 

Senior Kubernetes Platform Engineer 

Role Summary 

Firmus runs large-scale, state-of-the-art AI infrastructure built on the latest generation of GPU rack-scale systems and operated as one estate to power the next generation of AI innovation. The Senior Kubernetes Platform Engineer runs the Kubernetes estate that every product and every tenant runs on: the platform controller layer, the virtual cluster platform tenants are provisioned onto, the Kubernetes environment baselines used across the estate, the GPU integration layer, and the automated tenant onboarding and release pipeline. 

This is a hands-on senior role with deep technical expertise . This role owns the platform lifecycle execution across the fleet : keeping clusters healthy and current across the fleet, keeping tenant workloads running through upgrade and failure, and restoring control planes to service when they degrade . Automation is a first-class part of the role , in the operational tooling, guarded remediation and fleet orchestration that make estate-scale operation possible, delivered as controlled code and reviewed by AI Infrastructure where it affects service behaviour. 

Key Responsibilities 

- Responsible for the reliable operation, automation and continuous improvement of the multi-tenant Kubernetes platform that Firmus' products and tenants run on, spanning every site in the estate. 

- Build the operational tooling, guarded remediation and orchestration that automate operations at fleet scale, and contribute operator and controller requirements, and code where agreed, to AI Infrastructure's platform backlog with the production evidence behind them. 

- Execute the Kubernetes cluster lifecycle across the fleet, including provisioning, patching, upgrade and decommissioning, running the deployment and upgrade mechanisms built by AI Infrastructure through the agreed staged or canary path, and holding estate version compliance and retirement coordination. 

- Operate and recover Kubernetes control planes carrying live tenant workload, including etcd state, certificate rotation, failed upgrades and corrupted resources. 

- Operate the virtual cluster platform and multi-tenant isolation patterns that tenants are provisioned onto, and the automated tenant onboarding and release pipeline that lands new tenants safely and repeatably. 

- Operate the GPU integration layer for Kubernetes (for example the NVIDIA GPU Operator), including device plugins, GPU scheduling and driver coordination. 

- Diagnose and resolve scheduling failures, CNI and CSI faults, admission rejections and resource contention from first principles, and drive continuous improvement in cluster validation, CI/CD automation, and provisioning and testing frameworks. 

- Run the Kubernetes baselines in production carrying the admission policy, workload identity and network policy content set by the Senior Platform Security Engineer, and hold the operational acceptance requirements those baselines have to meet before they enter production. 

- Provide the deepest technical expertise for Kubernetes faults across the estate, diagnosing the faults that require internals-level knowledge to root cause, and driving the permanent fix to closure through AI Infrastructure , and mentor the engineers who carry frontline diagnosis, documenting operational procedures, runbooks and performance results. 

- Lead technical recovery during major Kubernetes incidents under the incident commander, drive the changes that remove repeat causes through the problem record, and share the after-hours escalation roster for the Kubernetes estate. 

Skills & Experience 

Required Skills

title: Machine Learning Engineer, Robotics
description:
Build the Path Forward 

At Path Robotics , we’re building the future of embodied intelligence. Our AI-driven systems enable robots to adapt, learn, and perform in the real world closing the skilled labor gap and transforming industries. We go beyond traditional methods, combining perception, reasoning, and control to deliver field-ready AI that is risk-aware, reliable, and continuously improving through real-world use.

Big, hard problems are our everyday work, and our team of intelligent, humble, and driven people make the impossible possible together.

We're seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join our Robotics team. You'll use machine learning to improve how our robots plan, scan, and act. Your models run on live robots doing real work for customers.

What You'll Do 

- Frame open-ended problems in planning, scanning, and robot behavior as well-defined ML problems.

- Train models that work with classical methods, such as initial guesses and learned costs for trajectory optimization, plan quality and feasibility predictors, and learned collision models.

- Apply imitation learning, reinforcement learning, and generative models such as diffusion and flow matching where they outperform classical baselines.

- Build production ML pipelines: datasets from fleet logs and simulation, training, and metrics.

- Evaluate models in the loop, with offline metrics that predict gains on the robot, failure-mode analysis, and calibrated confidence that determines when the system falls back to classical methods.

- Own your models end to end, from prototype to deployment on live robotic cells, with low-latency inference and monitoring.

Who You Are 

- An MS or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Machine Learning, or a related field.

- 4+ years of applied machine learning for robotics or autonomy, in research or industry.

- Fluent in Python with PyTorch or JAX, and experienced training, evaluating, and deploying deep learning models.

- Strong foundations in linear algebra, 3D geometry, kinematics, and optimization.

- You've run your methods on real robot hardware.

- You explain model results and their limits clearly, so planning, perception, and field teams know when to trust them.

Preferred 

- C++, and experience deploying models into a C++ or ROS 2 production stack.

- Motion planning, trajectory optimization, or collision checking.

- Active perception, next-best-view or informative path planning, or 3D point cloud learning.

- Uncertainty estimation and calibration, or Bayesian and information-theoretic planning.

- GPU inference optimization (CUDA, TensorRT, ONNX).

- Simulation and sim-to-real transfer (Isaac Lab, MuJoCo).

title: Senior Security GRC Engineer
description:
Why Mozilla? 

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we're shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. About this team and role: 

The role is part of the Security Function within the broader Mozilla Infrastructure team. The Security team supports Product, Enterprise and GRC functions across the organization aligned with the mission to build a safe & secure internet. This role is responsible for defining, developing and helping implement a Governance, Risk and Compliance framework for both Enterprise and Product verticals. The ideal candidate will be responsible to deliver an integrated framework that aligns security, privacy, regulatory, and risk management initiatives across the organization. This is an ideal role for someone early in their GRC or security career who is curious, organized, and eager to take on a wide range of work. You’ll get broad exposure across risk, audit, and a growing set of security programs. 

What you'll do: 

Risk Management 

- Perform risk assessments and process incoming risk questions and intake requests 

- Maintain the risk register, keeping entries accurate, current, and well documented 

- Track risk treatment plans and follow up with owners on progress 

- Manage the exceptions and issues tracking process, including intake, documentation, expiration follow-up, and reporting 

- Support third-party risk activities, such as vendor assessments, questionnaire review, and tracking remediation 

Compliance and Audit 

- Coordinate evidence collection from control owners and chase outstanding requests 

- Help prepare control owners and stakeholders for audit interviews 

- Keep the SOC 2 system description, ISMS documentation, and Statement of Applicability (SoA) up to date 

- Track audit gaps and findings and drive remediation to closure with control owners 

Security Program Support 

- Help GRC and partner teams run governance for the Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC), including tracking adoption, gathering evidence, and maintaining supporting standards

GRC Operations and Tooling

What you'll bring:

What you'll get:

title: Staff QE, Mobile
description:
About AlphaSense : 

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com . Come join us.

About the Team: 

Our diverse Product & Engineering team values innovation, collaboration, and the continuous improvement of our platform. We offer a dynamic work environment where employees can grow and thrive while working on cutting-edge technology that shapes the future of AI and search.

At AlphaSense, we believe that diverse experiences and perspectives are critical to our success. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued and empowered to be their authentic selves.

About the Role: 

Investors and analysts open our app between meetings, on a train, before a call, and act on what they see. Mobile releases go through app stores and cannot be rolled back, so a problem can stay in customers' hands for days.

Our mobile product is growing fast, with new AI workflows arriving on iPhone, iPad and Android at the pace of the rest of the platform. Our quality practice has real foundations, including Appium and native UI test suites and real-device runs, but our newest features are ahead of our automated coverage, and release confidence still depends too much on individual effort.

As Staff Quality Engineer, you own one question: can we ship mobile with confidence, every release, on all platforms? You decide what we test and what we deliberately leave out, and you turn what you build into a way of working that Mobile Engineering owns with you.

You will report to the head of Quality Engineering and work day to day with the iOS and Android teams, alongside backend, web and platform QE.

What Makes this a Staff role: 

- You set direction, not a task list. Nobody hands you a test plan. You look at the product, the release risk and the team, and decide what matters most and why.

- You own the outcome across platforms. Your scope is the quality of the product across clients, not one app or one team.

- You work through influence. You are an individual contributor. Your standards stick because engineers see their value, and success means they write more testable code, make better release calls and need you less over time.

What You’ll Do: 

- Define mobile quality strategy. Set the long-term strategy built on "Quality by Design" and "Automation by Default": test layers, device and OS matrix, and release criteria for iOS and Android.

- Set metrics the team can act on. Define quality metrics and coverage standards with Mobile Engineering and Product, so quality is measurable and sustainable without you.

- Turn release day into a clear call. With no instant rollback, own the quality gates, staged rollouts and evidence behind every go or no-go decision.

- Connect mobile to the rest of the platform. Mobile shares APIs and services with web, and customers update apps slowly, so changes elsewhere can break mobile after they have shipped. You are accountable for that risk.

- Make the test platform dependable. Keep real-device and CI runs stable and fast (Bitrise, BrowserStack, GitLab, Allure), including test data and enterprise (Intune/MDM) builds.

- Use AI where it earns its place. Use tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or Copilot yourself, and help the team decide where they help and where human judgment must lead.

- Leave the team stronger. Coach engineers and QEs, review designs for testability, and leave behind standards other teams adopt.

What Success looks like: 

- First 90 days: You have audited current coverage, agreed a prioritized plan with Mobile Engineering and delivered your first measurable improvement.

- By 6 months: Critical mobile journeys are covered in the right layers on both platforms, and release readiness is an evidence-based call.

- By 12 months: Mobile quality is a practice the team owns, and other portfolios borrow your ideas.

Who You Are: 

- A quality engineer with 8+ years of experience, including 2+ at Staff or Lead level. You have connected quality strategy across web and mobile, not just worked on mobile alone, and set direction across several teams or apps as an individual contributor without people-management authority. You can show what changed because of it.

- Strong hands-on experience testing native mobile apps on at least one platform (iOS or Android), with working knowledge of the other. You are comfortable with real-device cloud and CI/CD for mobile builds, can work with tools such as XCUITest, Espresso, Compose UI testing or Appium, and code in at least one language such as Kotlin, Java, Swift or Python.

- Strong debugging skills across the mobile stack, from crash reports to network traces, and a good understanding of how mobile releases move through the app stores.

- Excellent test design and API testing, and comfortable in the backend: you can read APIs, debug across the client and service boundary, and work with contracts.

- Strong understanding of continuous delivery and release gating, with experience in test management systems such as Allure TestOps.

- An active AI tool user, with examples of where it helped and where it fell short.

- Practical about trade-offs, and able to explain a release call to engineers and to non-technical leaders.

Bonus points: 

- Enterprise mobile experience (MDM/MAM, Intune, SSO, mobile security standards such as OWASP MASVS).

- Experience building a mobile quality practice from an early stage.

- Mobile performance testing (app start time, memory, battery) and release monitoring (crash and performance signals, staged rollouts).

- Experience across both iOS and Android.

What we offer: 

- Playing a part in the story of a fast-growing company

- Competitive compensation package

- Lunch and recreational benefits

- Occupational health care

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

- AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.

- If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page .

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
About Kaseya 

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners , a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it. 

Why Kaseya? 

Join a fast-growing company that’s transforming the IT industry. At Kaseya, you’ll have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology, collaborate with a dynamic team, and develop your career in a high impact role.

Join the Kaseya growth rocket ship and see how we are #ChangingLives!

Job Summary 

We’re hiring Platform Backend Engineers to build and operate the core services connecting workflow execution, identity, event routing, secrets management, and audit capabilities across Kaseya’s platform. This is a hands-on backend role focused on Go or Rust, event-driven systems, multi-tenant security, and production reliability. You’ll build foundational services used by engineering teams and AI-enabled workflows, with correctness, auditability, and operational clarity as core design requirements.

Roles & Responsibilities

- Improve platform observability, reliability, failure recovery, security, and operational readiness while supporting production incident response

Required Qualifications

- Experience designing event-driven systems using Kafka or similar technologies, including retries, idempotency, replay, and at-least-once delivery

- Experience implementing authentication and authorization using OAuth 2.0, OIDC, token lifecycle management, or fine-grained access controls

- Experience implementing encryption or key-management solutions using cloud KMS platforms, envelope encryption, or key-hierarchy designs

- Experience operating multi-tenant production systems using structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, and incident-response practices

- Experience integrating MSP, PSA, RMM, security, or Microsoft 365 platform APIs

- Experience building software for regulated environments subject to SOC 2, HIPAA, CMMC, or similar requirements

- Experience developing multi-cloud platform services across AWS, Azure, or GCP
