title: Principal AI & Automation Lead
description:
AI speelt een steeds grotere rol in hoe we onze producten verbeteren, klanten ondersteunen en interne processen slimmer inrichten. Maar de échte waarde van AI zit wat ons betreft niet in de technologie zelf, maar in wat we ermee kunnen bereiken.

Als onze AI & Automation Lead ontdek je waar AI het verschil kan maken. Je gaat met collega's uit verschillende afdelingen in gesprek, luistert naar hun ervaringen en uitdagingen en vertaalt ideeën en behoeften naar praktische oplossingen.

Dat doe je niet alleen achter je eigen scherm. Je organiseert workshops, helpt collega's met verschillende niveaus van technische kennis op weg met AI, experimenteert met nieuwe technologie en bouwt zelf prototypes en automatiseringen.

Je krijgt veel vrijheid om kansen te ontdekken, prioriteiten te stellen en initiatieven van idee tot implementatie te begeleiden. Daarmee maak je niet alleen het werk van je collega's makkelijker en leuker, maar draag je ook bij aan betere producten en dienstverlening voor onze 270.000 klanten.

Wie zijn wij?

Mijndomein is een van de grootste en laatste onafhankelijke hostingproviders van Nederland. Omdat we volledig in privébezit zijn, groeien we op onze eigen manier: wendbaar, klantgericht en met een langetermijnvisie.

We nemen beslissingen met het belang van onze klanten én het bedrijf voor ogen. Inmiddels vertrouwen 270.000 klanten op onze diensten en beheren we meer dan 1 miljoen domeinnamen.

En omdat we geloven in samen bouwen, kunnen medewerkers via onze participatieregeling mede-eigenaar worden van de organisatie en zo meedelen in de waarde die we samen creëren.

Mijndomein is onderdeel van The Sharing Group, actief binnen Online, Mobiliteit en Energie

Wat ga je doen?

Als AI & Automation Lead speel je een belangrijke rol bij het inzetten van AI binnen Mijndomein. Je houdt je bezig met interne bedrijfsprocessen én toepassingen die onze producten en dienstverlening verbeteren.

Concreet betekent dit dat je: 

- Kansen ontdekt en prioriteiten stelt: je brengt ons huidige AI-gebruik in kaart, ontdekt verbeterkansen en bepaalt samen met collega's welke initiatieven de meeste waarde opleveren.

- Processen automatiseert: je ontwikkelt praktische automatiseringen en AI-workflows die repetitief werk verminderen en collega's tijd besparen.

- Collega's verder helpt: je organiseert toegankelijke trainingen en workshops, ondersteunt collega's bij het gebruik van AI en deelt succesvolle toepassingen tussen afdelingen.

- Ideeën tot leven brengt: je bouwt prototypes en pilots om nieuwe toepassingen te testen. Voor grotere of complexere oplossingen werk je samen met onze developers.

- Tools beoordeelt: je onderzoekt bestaande en nieuwe AI-tools en adviseert over hun toegevoegde waarde, bruikbaarheid, toegankelijkheid, veiligheid en mogelijke risico's.

- Resultaten zichtbaar maakt: je onderzoekt wat toepassingen daadwerkelijk opleveren, bijvoorbeeld in tijdsbesparing, kwaliteit of klanttevredenheid.

- Vooruitkijkt: je volgt relevante AI-ontwikkelingen en helpt op basis van nieuwe inzichten onze AI-strategie verder vorm te geven.

Daarbij draait het niet om zoveel mogelijk AI-tools introduceren, maar om oplossingen die daadwerkelijk iets toevoegen. Niet ieder probleem heeft AI nodig en niet ieder experiment hoeft een succes te worden. We vinden het belangrijk om samen te leren van wat wel én niet werkt.

We zoeken iemand die enthousiast wordt van nieuwe technologie, maar nog veel enthousiaster van wat je ermee kunt oplossen.

Je hebt ervaring met het zelfstandig begeleiden van AI-projecten van idee tot implementatie. Je bent technisch onderlegd, bouwt graag zelf oplossingen en weet wanneer het waardevol is om de kennis en expertise van anderen te betrekken.

Je kunt omgaan met een rol waarin nog niet alles vastligt. Je neemt initiatief, brengt structuur aan en helpt collega's om nieuwe technologie te begrijpen en te benutten, op een manier die aansluit bij hun kennis en behoeften.

Hoe je jouw kennis en ervaring hebt opgedaan, vinden we minder belangrijk dan wat je ermee kunt bereiken. Of je nu een technische opleiding hebt gevolgd, jezelf veel hebt aangeleerd of vanuit een ander vakgebied in AI en automatisering bent terechtgekomen: we zijn benieuwd naar wat jij meebrengt.

Wat breng je mee? 

- Ervaring met het implementeren van AI-oplossingen, automatiseringen of vergelijkbare technologische verbeteringen binnen organisaties.

- De technische kennis om zelfstandig prototypes, AI-workflows en automatiseringen te ontwikkelen.

- Kennis van API's, integraties en moderne AI-tools, en inzicht in hoe je verschillende systemen met elkaar kunt laten samenwerken.

- Het vermogen om zelfstandig projecten te begeleiden, prioriteiten te stellen en onderscheid te maken tussen interessante experimenten en waardevolle oplossingen.

- Het vermogen om technische onderwerpen begrijpelijk te maken voor verschillende doelgroepen en collega's te ondersteunen bij veranderingen.

- Oog voor privacy, informatiebeveiliging en verantwoord gebruik van AI, waaronder mogelijke vooroordelen en risico's van AI-toepassingen.

- Ervaring met het ontwikkelen van toepassingen rondom LLM's, AI-agents of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).

- Een nieuwsgierige, praktische en resultaatgerichte aanpak, waarbij je openstaat voor feedback en verschillende perspectieven.

Mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste: 

- Ervaring met programmeertalen zoals Python of JavaScript.

- Ervaring met automatiseringsplatformen zoals n8n, Make of vergelijkbare tools.

- Ervaring met het organiseren van workshops, trainingen of interne kennissessies.

- Affiniteit met hosting, SaaS of andere technische dienstverlening.

Herken je jezelf in deze rol, maar voldoe je niet aan alle punten? Laat je daardoor niet tegenhouden om te solliciteren. We kijken graag naar jouw kennis, ervaring, potentieel en motivatie.

Wat bieden wij?

Stick Together, Own It & Be Bold. Dat zijn onze kernwaarden en die zie je terug in hoe we samenwerken.

Bij Mijndomein krijg je de vrijheid om ideeën niet alleen aan te dragen, maar ook daadwerkelijk uit te voeren. We helpen elkaar, geven ruimte aan verschillende perspectieven en waarderen initiatief, constructieve feedback en de bereidheid om te experimenteren en te leren.

We geloven dat verschillende achtergronden, ervaringen en manieren van denken ons als organisatie sterker maken. We vinden het belangrijk dat iedereen zichzelf kan zijn, zich gehoord voelt en de ruimte krijgt om zich te ontwikkelen.

We zijn goed ingericht op hybride werken, maar vinden het ook belangrijk om elkaar regelmatig te ontmoeten. Daarom werk je minimaal twee dagen per week op ons kantoor in Almere, op dinsdag en donderdag . Regelmatig komt daar ook de maandag bij, waardoor je vaak drie dagen per week op kantoor bent.

Daarnaast bieden we: 

- Een passend salaris, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring.

- Internet-, telefonie- en thuiswerkvergoeding.

- €750 per jaar voor boeken, workshops, seminars of andere dingen die bijdragen aan jouw ontwikkeling.

- Een aanvullend studiebudget van €2.500 per jaar .

- Een vast aantal studie-uren per jaar, zodat je ook daadwerkelijk tijd kunt besteden aan je ontwikkeling.

- €550 voor het inrichten van je thuiswerkplek.

- Onze participatieregeling Good Shares , waarmee je mede-eigenaar kunt worden van de organisatie.

- Een pensioenbijdrage van 5,3% , volledig door ons betaald.

- Reiskostenvergoeding en een NS-Business Card. Ons kantoor zit pal naast station Almere Centraal.

- En verschillende extra's, zoals stoelmassages, vers bereide (warme) lunches op kantoor en korting op je sportabonnement.

Enthousiast?

Krijg jij energie van het ontdekken van mogelijkheden, het bouwen van slimme oplossingen en het helpen van anderen om technologie écht te benutten?

Dan maken we graag kennis met je! 

We zijn vooral benieuwd naar wat je hebt gebouwd, welke verbeteringen je hebt gerealiseerd, wat je onderweg hebt geleerd en hoe jij AI binnen een organisatie als Mijndomein zou aanpakken. Dat mag vanuit je werkervaring zijn, maar ook vanuit eigen projecten of andere initiatieven.

Bij ons is iedereen welkom om te solliciteren, ongeacht achtergrond, leeftijd, gender, identiteit of persoonlijke omstandigheden.

Heb je tijdens de sollicitatieprocedure bepaalde ondersteuning of aanpassingen nodig? Laat het ons gerust weten, dan kijken we samen naar de mogelijkheden.

title: Senior Decision Scientist, Trust & Safety
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. 
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

You’ll become part of the Trust’s Detection team, with a mission to protect the Vinted community from harmful activities and content. The Detection team in the Trust domain is engaged in detecting, understanding, and stopping illegal, dangerous or inappropriate content within the Vinted Marketplace. As a Senior Decision Scientist embedded in a product team, you will become part of a cross-functional team and drive quality decisions by bringing actionable insights from data. 

You will lead hypothesis-driven product experimentation, translating data into actionable insights and product improvements. You will design and evaluate experiments with support from experienced stakeholders, ensuring rigorous validation of results and a clear, measurable impact, while maintaining high standards of data quality and accessibility.

In this position, you’ll 

- Partner with your team and stakeholders to identify strategic opportunities and provide data-driven recommendations and answer critical business questions.

- Work alongside other decision scientists to detect and investigate specific fraud patterns.

- Test and analyse opportunities to validate their value and understand their business impact, using statistical methods and visualisation tools.

- Select, calculate, and monitor your team's key performance indicators, proactively flagging issues, running analyses, and understanding root causes.

- Enable your team and direct stakeholders to independently leverage data for business insights via self-service dashboards.

- Contribute to a data-driven culture by promoting best practices in analytics and decision-making to make data count.

About you 

- Extensive proven working experience as a Decision Scientist, Data Analyst, Data Scientist or a related position.

- Good analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance depth of analysis with business impact.

- Familiarity with SQL and Python for data analytics.

- Experience with BI tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI).

- Knowledge of statistical methods, such as A/B testing, regression analysis, and other inferential techniques.

- Highly results-oriented and comfortable with iterative processes.

- Strong communicator who can convincingly present results to both technical and non-technical audiences.

- Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

- Advantage: experience working in the Trust & Safety or Fraud-related area.

- Advantage: previous experience working in product teams.

Work perks 

- The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme

- 25 days of paid annual leave

- Newest MacBook models

- Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family

- Frequent team-building events

- Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture

- Lunch benefit per working day

- A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted

- Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan

- NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport

- Company bike leasing scheme

- Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform

- Work from Home allowance

- A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy 

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget 

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work 

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity 

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

title: Werkstudent Data & AI (m/w/d)
description:
Wir sind BetterDoc, ein Digital-Health-Unternehmen mit über 200 Mitarbeitenden in Köln und Basel. Wir unterstützen Patienten mit schweren Erkrankungen und komplexen Diagnosen dabei, die passenden Spezialisten für ihr Anliegen zu finden. Dafür bündeln, strukturieren und analysieren wir qualitätsrelevante Daten aus dem Gesundheitswesen. Seit 2012 haben wir über 100.000 Patienten begleitet. Seit 2022 gehören wir zur Otto Group und arbeiten eng mit unserem Schwesterunternehmen Medgate zusammen, einem der führenden Telemedizin-Anbieter Europas.

Du studierst Medizin und probierst nebenbei schon aus, was mit KI alles geht? Bei uns bringst du beides zusammen. Du testest Prompts für echten Datenanfragen, prüfst KI-Ergebnisse mit deinem medizinischen Wissen und baust kleine Prototypen mit. Und du erlebst, wie daraus Produkte werden.

Unser Team

Medical Science ist der medizinische Kern von BetterDoc. Wir übersetzen medizinisches Wissen in Produkte: strukturierte Daten, Entscheidungslogik und zunehmend KI. Ärztinnen und Ärzte bauen bei uns selbst Prototypen und bringen sie gemeinsam mit Product und Engineering live. Als Werkstudent arbeitest du direkt in diesem Team mit.

Zur Verstärkung suchen wir ab sofort einen Werkstudenten (m/w/d) am Standort Köln oder remote.

Deine Aufgaben

Im Tagesgeschäft

- Medizinische Datenbank pflegen: Du hältst unsere medizinische Datenbank aktuell. Du recherchierst gezielt, bereitest Daten strukturiert auf und validierst sie systematisch.

- Analysen und Reportings: Du wirkst bei Auswertungen medizinischer Daten für interne Entscheidungen mit.

- Prozesse weiterentwickeln: Du hilfst dabei, Arbeitsprozesse und Konzepte rund um unsere Datenbank weiterzuentwickeln und zu automatisieren.

KI und Prototypen

- Prompts und Prototypen mitentwickeln: Du schreibst und testest Prompts und baust gemeinsam mit dem Team kleine Werkzeuge, zum Beispiel mit Claude, Python, SQL oder Google Apps Script.

- KI-Ergebnisse medizinisch prüfen: Du bewertest Ergebnisse unserer KI-Anwendungen fachlich, baust Test- und Referenzdatensätze mit auf und findest Fehler, bevor sie bei Patienten ankommen.

- Medizinisches Wissen strukturieren: Du überführst medizinische Informationen in strukturierte Daten und Klassifikationen wie ICD, OPS und SNOMED CT.

- Mit dem Produktteam zusammenarbeiten: Du bringst deine medizinische Perspektive in die Weiterentwicklung unserer internen Systeme mit Product und Engineering ein und siehst, wie ein Prototyp zum Produkt wird.

title: Flight Control Intern - Stabilizing Unstable Aircraft
description:
About Us 

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the role 

As a Flight Control Intern, you explore how far an aircraft can be pushed beyond natural stability, and what performance that buys. Instability makes aircraft more agile, but only if the control system can keep them flying. You own your project end to end: you choose and build unstable airframes, identify their dynamics from flight data, design the control that stabilizes them, and measure the limits of what can be achieved. You work on agile, high-performance platforms in a fast-paced engineering team with an industrial, production-first mindset, flying frequently on a dedicated test range. You are a full member of the team, with visibility on how the company and its products evolve and a direct impact on what we ship.

Responsibilities 
Select and justify unstable configurations to study, such as multirotor and VTOL (vertical take-off and landing), relaxed-stability fixed wings, and tailless, blended-wing or canard layouts.

- Design and build the airframes yourself (foam, 3D printing, composites), integrate the avionics provided by the team, and repair after crashes.

- Plan and run flight test campaigns with excitation maneuvers, and iterate quickly on a dedicated test range.

- Identify the aircraft dynamics from flight data (system identification) and validate the models against analytical and simulated results.

- Design and tune stabilizing controllers on PX4 or ArduPilot, then port them to Harmattan's in-house flight controller firmware.

- Push the instability step by step, for example by moving the center of gravity aft or reducing control surfaces, and analyze stability margins.

- Quantify the performance envelope, including the limits set by actuator bandwidth, sensor noise and latency, and the agility gained in return.

- Build a reusable toolchain: a Python simulation workflow (for example JSBSim or Gazebo) validated on flight data, hardware-in-the-loop tests, flight test procedures and a data analysis pipeline.

- Present concepts, results, and project status to the team and to wider audiences, and join team meetings to learn from other projects.

Candidate Requirements 

- Currently pursuing an MSc in Aerospace Engineering, Control, Robotics, or a related field.

- Solid foundations in flight mechanics and control theory, ideally with experience in system identification or stability analysis.

- Proficiency in Python. C/C++ and embedded firmware experience is a plus.

- Hands-on building experience, such as RC aircraft, drones, or any fabrication project. Familiarity with PX4 or ArduPilot is a plus.

- Comfort with flight testing, debugging in the field, and learning from the occasional crash.

- Motivated, autonomous, and proactive, with the ability to own a project and communicate results clearly.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

Every airframe Harmattan AI flies starts with a model. System identification turns flight data into the verified dynamics that guidance and control are designed, tuned and trained on. It is the foundation of an autopilot that adapts across multirotors, fixed wings, VTOLs and missiles.

As a Flight Mechanics Engineer - System Identification, working out of Zurich, you will own the path from flight test to identified model. You will design and run your own experiments, build a repeatable identification pipeline, and deliver models the G&C team can trust.

Responsibilities 

- Experiment Design & Flight Test: Plan and run your own identification tests, from excitation design to flight tests, including coordinating with the .

- Model Identification: Identify rigid-body, aerodynamic, propulsion and actuator dynamics using frequency and time-domain methods, including closed-loop identification on vehicles flown under a controller.

- Propulsion & Actuators: Characterize motors, ESCs, propellers and control surfaces, including bandwidth, delays, saturation, and thermal and battery effects.

- Identification Pipeline: Build and maintain an automated, reproducible pipeline from flight logs to identified model. This covers ingestion, data-quality checks, estimation, validation and reporting.

- Model Validation: Validate models against held-out flight data, quantify uncertainty, and make sure each model is fit for purpose: controller design, simulation, or training learned G&C.

- New Airframes: Extend the capability from multirotors to control-surface multirotors, fixed wings, tail-sitters and missiles.

- Simulation & G&C Support: Deliver models into simulation, SITL and HITL, and work closely with control, guidance and embedded engineers to close the loop between models and flight results.

- Mentorship: Depending on seniority, support the team by mentoring junior engineers and interns.

Candidate Requirements 

- Educational Background: A strong academic record with a degree in aerospace, control, mechanical engineering or a related STEM field. A practical track record matters more than the specific degree.

- System Identification: Proven experience identifying dynamic models of flying platforms from real data, in both the frequency and time domain, including the pitfalls of closed-loop data.

- Flight Mechanics & Control: Solid grasp of rigid-body dynamics, aerodynamic forces and moments, non-dimensionalization, stability modes and propulsion models. Also enough control background to know what the model will be used for.

- Flight Testing: Hands-on experience planning and running flight tests and working from raw, imperfect logs.

- Software: Strong Python and scientific computing skills, with the discipline to build tools others can rerun.

- Rigorous about data quality, uncertainty and validation; skeptical of models until they are proven.

- Autonomous and hands-on, comfortable moving between bench, field and code.

- Communicates clearly, able to present models and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders.

- Thrives under pressure in a fast-paced environment with a no-task-is-too-small mentality.

- Fixed-wing aerodynamic modeling; VTOL or tail-sitter dynamics; remote pilot certification; experience with real flight logs; structural or vibration modes; data-driven or learned dynamics models.

- Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI’s mission of providing a defensive edge to allied nations through ethical, high-impact technology.

description:
DATA SCIENTIST (H/F) 

STAGE MASTER II - 6 mois

Rejoignez le Groupe INTESCIA, leader de la Business Intelligence en Europe ! 

Qui sommes-nous ? 
Chez Intescia, nous transformons la donnée en levier de croissance. Leader européen de la Data Intelligence, nous opérons le portefeuille de données et de solutions le plus complet du marché pour aider les entreprises à détecter plus vite les opportunités, mieux comprendre leurs marchés et décider avec impact.

Présents en France, en Espagne, en Italie et en Belgique, nous réalisons plus de 75 M€ de chiffre d'affaires et figurons parmi les 50 plus grands acteurs de l'industrie du logiciel et de la data en France. Au quotidien, des milliers d'entreprises s'appuient sur nos solutions pour accélérer leur business.

Contexte du stage 

Les LLMs (Large Language Model) sont des outils efficaces, rapides à prendre en main et généralistes, ce qui en fait un choix technique facile pour une grande partie des projets de traitement du langage naturel. Ils ont supplanté une partie des algorithmes de Data Science plus « classiques ».

Cependant, ils ne sont pas exempts de défauts. Ils sont extrêmement coûteux en énergie, coûteux en eaux, coûteux financièrement et ils nécessitent d’importants investissements (création de Data Centers) pour être mis en place.

Dans une volonté de contrôle des données produites et utilisées par l’entreprise (et plus largement de toutes données privées), il est important de garantir que les données traitées soient protégées, ce que l’usage de certains LLMs ne garantit pas. Nous venons par ailleurs de vivre en France, une série de canicules les plus importantes de ces dernières décennies, avec des records de température dans de nombreuses villes françaises. Il est nécessaire de prendre des actions pour aller vers des technologies plus sobres en énergie.

Par ailleurs, le monde de l’IA connaît une période d’incertitude, avec une course effrénée vers des modèles généralistes de plus en plus gros et de plus en plus gloutons en espace comme en énergie. Dans ce contexte, nous souhaitons nous orienter vers des méthodes plus « frugales ». Nous souhaitons ainsi de préférence adapter de petits modèles à des tâches très précises, qui ont l’avantage d’être plus parcimonieux. Un axe principal du travail sera donc de construire des modèles dont la création sera standardisée, avec un minimum de paramétrage à effectuer, et moins de labellisation manuelle à fournir. Nous souhaitons proposer une méthode qui soit la plus générique possible (voir en appui sur les approches MCP/ADK). Les questions clés sont de déterminer s’il est possible de répertorier, créer et tester des modèles pour nos cas d’usages, et de quantifier le gain énergétique de ces modèles en comparaison avec d’anciennes techniques présentes dans le groupe.

Votre mission : 

L’objectif principal du stage est de produire un benchmark et une analyse complète des outils de Data Science proposés par Explore. Ce travail sera complété par une bibliographie des domaines dans lesquels s’inscrivent les solutions proposées.

Enfin, ce stage est prévu pour aboutir à une thèse CIFRE, et l’étudiant.e sera encouragé.e à participer à la rédaction du sujet de thèse.

Des déplacements ponctuels au L3i de La Rochelle seront également prévus.

Les livrables attendus pour ce stage sont :

• Un état de l’art des approches existantes et de l’état des technologies utilisées par Explore

• Un benchmark de ces approches sur des données de l’entreprise

• Une publication scientifique résumant tout ce travail.

Ce stage sera rémunéré à hauteur de 1000€ mensuel. 

Informations importantes 

ð Ce stage sera suivi d’une thèse CIFRE d’une durée de trois ans, financée par le groupe Intescia ;

ð Ce stage est co-encadré entre le laboratoire L3i de La Rochelle Université et Explore, filiale du groupe Intescia.

Le L3i (Laboratoire Informatique, Image et Interaction) est le laboratoire de recherche en informatique de La Rochelle Université, créé en 1993 et labellisé Équipe de Recherche Technologique. Il rassemble une centaine de membres, dont 32 enseignants-chercheurs, une trentaine de doctorants et 7 personnels permanents de soutien à la recherche, répartis en trois équipes : « Dynamique des systèmes et adaptativité », « Images et contenus », et « Modèles et connaissances ». Il dispose d’une expertise reconnue internationalement autour de l’analyse et de la compréhension de documents, notamment administratifs.

Les encadrants du côté laboratoire sont : Antoine Doucet et Mickael Coustaty. 

Du côté Explore : Julie Queiros, avec une participation ponctuelle du manager de l’équipe, Steven Hellec. 

• Les étapes du recrutement seront les suivantes : 

- 1er entretien avec Julie QUEIROS , DATA SCIENTIST chez Explore, accompagnée du personnel encadrant du laboratoire ;

- 2ème entretien et restitution de cas pratique avec Julie, accompagnée de son N+1 Steven HELLEC, ainsi que des encadrants du laboratoire ;

- 3ème et dernier entretien avec l’équipe RH, pour tout formaliser.

Le profil que nous recherchons 

- Étudiant·e de Master 2 dans les domaines suivants : Informatique / Mathématiques Information / Statistiques / Traitement du langage naturel / Data Science. 

- Appétence à la recherche

description:

About Life360

Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 107.7 million monthly active users (MAU), as of September 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries. 

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com .

Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above. 

We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

This role sits on the Verticals team within Life360 — the group building the next frontier of meaningful connection beyond the core family circle. This role's initial focus is Aging in Place: helping aging parents stay safely independent while giving the families around them real peace of mind. Over time, this role may flex to support other emerging verticals — Things (Tile, connected trackers) or Pets — as priorities shift, so we're looking for someone who wants to help define the pattern for new member segments, not just ship one feature set.

We are a product-minded, AI-Native engineering team. That means AI isn't just a tool we use — it's how we work. We've redesigned our team workflows around AI, treating it as a first-class collaborator at every stage: ideation, coding, testing, review, and iteration. We ship faster and go deeper because of it, and we're looking for someone who wants to help define what that looks like at scale.

About the Job

Life360 is hiring an AI Native Senior Software Engineer — a senior engineer who doesn't just use AI tools, but thinks natively in them. You'll be central to how the Verticals team builds products.

You'll design and build features that serve one of our most important and fastest-growing member segments: aging parents who want to stay safely connected with, and independent from, the families who care about them. As priorities change, you may also apply these same patterns to Things (connected trackers) or Pets.

You will take full ownership of what you build from the first line of code through production, on-call, and the member impact it has. You obsess over the humans on the other end of the product, not just the ticket.

Full-stack experience is required for this role — you should be comfortable moving between backend services and the mobile surfaces that expose them. Our stack spans Spring Boot microservices, Java, Kafka, and Kafka Streams on the backend, a modern cloud-native platform on AWS, and native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin) apps on the client side.

In your first year, success looks like having shipped end-to-end features serving the Aging in Place member segment and establishing at least one AI-native workflow the broader team adopts.

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) , as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits. 

What You’ll Do

- Ship end-to-end across the stack — from backend services and APIs through to the iOS and Android surfaces members use, serving tens of millions of users — moving between layers as the feature demands.

- Work with AI (Claude Code) as a first-class collaborator — orchestrate agents to create specs, generate code, and perform reviews, moving faster without sacrificing quality.

- Define and codify AI-Native engineering practices for the Verticals team, establishing playbooks the broader org can adopt.

- Collaborate closely with product managers and designers to turn complex user problems into scalable engineering solutions.

- Contribute to architectural decisions, code reviews, and a culture of craft and continuous improvement.

- Participate in on-call rotation and incident response.

- Mentor team members and contribute to team processes and technical standards.

- Support performance, reliability, and accessibility across the features you own.

- Adapt patterns and services built for Aging in Place to future verticals (Things, Pets) as team scope expands.

What We’re Looking For

- 4+ years of experience building and operating high-quality, consumer-scale services.

- 1+ years of hands-on experience prompting, evaluating, and building with LLMs.

- Full-stack proficiency spanning backend services (Java, Spring Boot, Kafka) and mobile client development (Swift for iOS and/or Kotlin for Android), with the versatility to work across the whole stack as needed.

Nice-to-Have

AI-Native Expectations

We use AI coding tools as a professional standard on this team. Here's what that means in practice:

- Daily use: You use AI coding assistants (we support Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot) for real, substantive tasks: analysis, coding, refactoring, testing, navigating codebases, and documentation. Not just research or autocomplete but as a development partner.

title: Compiler Engineer - Machine Learning Compiler
description:
About us 

Mythic is building the future of AI computing with breakthrough analog technology that delivers 100× the performance of traditional digital systems at the same power and cost. This unlocks bigger, more capable models and faster, more responsive applications—whether in edge devices like drones, robotics, and sensors, or in cloud and data center environments. Our technology powers everything from large language models and CNNs to advanced signal processing, and is engineered to operate from –40 °C to +125 °C, making it ideal for industrial, automotive, aerospace, and defense.

We’ve raised over $100M from world-class investors including Softbank, Threshold Ventures, Lux Capital, and DCVC, and secured multi-million-dollar customer contracts across multiple markets.

About the role 

Join us in building the next generation of AI compilers. You’ll play a key role in developing the compiler for our novel AI accelerator, working side-by-side with hardware engineers and ML researchers. Your work will shape how deep learning workloads run on cutting-edge dataflow hardware—defining the instruction set, execution model, and developer experience. The result: a compiler that delivers breakthrough performance while remaining seamless and intuitive for ML developers.

Here's what you will do

- Contribute across the full compiler stack, including operator lowering, graph/IR transformations, optimization passes, and backend code generation

- Optimize for dataflow architectures, developing pipelined schedules, memory orchestration, and resource-constrained execution strategies

- Collaborate with hardware architects to influence architectural features, ensuring the compiler and hardware evolve together

- Develop compilation strategies that unify our analog compute with digital subsystems

- Build and maintain a compiler that produces high-performance binaries with strong debugging support, clear error messages, and predictable performance models

Here's the background we hope you will have

- 3+ years of experience building compilers or high-performance systems software, especially those involving complex resource management or optimization. 

- Expert in modern C++ (C++14/17/20) and strong Python.

- Experience with compiler IRs (SSA-based or graph-based), transformations, and code generation

- Exposure to specialized accelerators (GPU, NPU, FPGA, or custom ASIC) or parallel architectures

The following would be nice to have, but is not required

- Experience with machine learning compiler stacks (e.g., ONNX, MLIR, TVM, XLA, IREE, PyTorch), with contributions to MLIR or LLVM projects a plus

- Experience with optimization methods (LP/MIP, CP, SAT/SMT) using solvers like Gurobi or OR-Tools for scheduling and resource allocation

- Experience compiling for specialized accelerators (GPU, NPU, FPGA, or custom ASIC) on DNN workloads; GPU/DSP experience is valuable if combined with compiler backend work beyond kernel tuning

- Familiarity with heterogeneous compilation, especially mixing custom accelerators with CPUs/GPUs/NPUs, and exposure to analog or in-memory compute is a plus

- Experience collaborating in compiler–hardware co-design (architecture + ISA) for better compiler usability and hardware efficiency

What we offer

- The opportunity to shape how deep learning and LLM workloads are compiled on novel hardware.

- A role that spans software and hardware co-design, shaping both the compiler and the accelerator architecture

- A collaborative, innovative team that values engineering rigor, continuous integration, and user-focused design. We foster an environment of shared learning and technical excellence

- Competitive compensation, equity, and benefits package

Compensation

Additional Information

At Mythic, we foster a collaborative and respectful environment where people can do their best work. We hire smart, capable individuals, provide the tools and support they need, and trust them to deliver. Our team brings a wide range of experiences and perspectives, which we see as a strength in solving hard problems together. We value professionalism, creativity, and integrity, and strive to make Mythic a place where every employee feels they belong and can contribute meaningfully.

title: Scientist, Model Validation and Experimental Data Analysis
description:
WHO WE ARE 

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

TEAM AND ROLE 

- Shape the architecture of the world’s first commercial fusion power plant – Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale.

- Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in industry – Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning product.

- Build real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION 

- You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

- You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

- Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

- Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT 

You will make Proxima's plasma simulation stack trustworthy by confronting it with reality. Every prediction we make for Alpha – Proxima's Q>1 experimental stellarator – and for Stellaris, our commercial power plant, rests on models whose credibility has to be earned against real measurements from an operating device.

W7-X is where we earn it. You will take our integrated modeling framework, FUS3, and our Bayesian plasma state estimation workflow to W7-X data: reconstruct the plasma state from diagnostic measurements, compare our predictive models against what the machine actually did, and turn the discrepancies into a prioritized map of where our physics is right, where it is not, and what we must fix before Alpha's first plasma. Modeling sits on Alpha's operational critical path and cannot be backfilled after first plasma – this role is how we get ahead of it.

You will be the person in the group who lives at the intersection of modeling and experiment: fluent enough in the physics to know what a model should predict, and close enough to the diagnostics to know what the data can actually support.

WHAT YOU WILL DO 

- Validate Proxima's predictive plasma models against W7-X experimental data – neoclassical and turbulent transport, 3D equilibrium, ECRH deposition, pellet fueling and drift, bootstrap current and iota evolution – and record each comparison as a reproducible validation report with quantitative agreement metrics, stated limitations, and a pinned regression test

- Reconstruct the plasma state from real diagnostic measurements using our time-dependent Bayesian state-estimation workflow (Thomson scattering, interferometry, CXRS, ECE, XICS, bolometry, magnetics), with calibrated uncertainties, and benchmark it against established analyses such as Minerva/IDA reconstructions and ASTRA power-balance results

- Work with raw and pre-processed diagnostic data, not just analyzed profiles – instrument geometry, sightlines, calibrations and the caveats that come with them – and own the forward models, noise models and profile fits that feed transport analysis

- Validate against databases of discharges rather than single shots, across W7-X magnetic configurations and operating regimes, so the output is a map of model applicability and parameter trends rather than one-off discrepancy reports

- Act as a technical interface to W7-X and IPP: scope and prioritize data requests, spend time on site in Greifswald working alongside diagnosticians and operators, and propose and support experiments that directly target our model gaps

- Feed validation back into design – convert diagnostic placement and observability studies on W7-X into requirements for Alpha's diagnostic set, and into realistic uncertainty models for the synthetic measurements we use to design against

- Extend the modeling stack itself: mappers from experimental archives into IMAS, synthetic diagnostics, and analysis workflows, so that interpreting a shot end-to-end – raw data to reconstructed plasma state to physics quantities – runs in minutes and is reproducible by anyone in the group

- As Alpha approaches operation, help stand up the between-shot analysis loop that will run on day one

WHO YOU ARE 

- PhD in plasma physics, fusion science, or a closely related discipline

- Hands-on experience with experimental data from a magnetic confinement device – you have dealt with diagnostics, calibrations, systematic errors, and all the ways real data is messier than simulation output

- Experience reconstructing the plasma state from measurements: profile fitting, integrated data analysis, equilibrium reconstruction, or power and particle balance analysis

- Strong grounding in transport, equilibrium, and heating physics – enough to tell a code bug from a physics discovery

- Rigorous about uncertainty; you treat a validation claim without error bars on both sides as incomplete

- Comfortable writing and maintaining scientific software – version control, testing, and reproducibility are habits, not overhead

- Can communicate effectively with physicists, diagnosticians, engineers, and experimentalists, and work productively inside an external collaboration

- Self-directed; able to identify what needs to be done and execute

- Willing to travel regularly to Greifswald, and later to the Alpha site

NICE TO HAVE 

- W7-X experience - operations, diagnostics, or data analysis, and familiarity with the W7-X data archive and Minerva

- Stellarator physics background

- Bayesian inference, uncertainty quantification, or machine learning applied to experimental data

- Experience with integrated modeling and transport codes (FUSE, OMFIT, ASTRA, TRANSP, FUSE, JINTRAC, or similar) and with neoclassical (SFINCS, DKES, NEO) or gyrokinetic (GENE, CGYRO, GX, or similar) codes

- Julia and Python programming – our integrated modeling framework is written in Julia

- Familiarity with the IMAS data model

- Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools

- A track record of published validation studies or successful experimental proposals

INTERVIEW PROCESS 

- Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

- Technical Screening (30 min)

- Technical Panel (3x60 min)

- Python.
- Outils et pratiques CI/CD.
- Intelligence Artificielle générative, LLM et prompt engineering.

Qualités attendues : 

- Esprit d'analyse et de synthèse.

title: Software Engineer (Python & Cloud)
description:
Build the software behind large-scale battery storage

Solar and wind power are not always available when we need electricity. Large-scale battery storage helps by storing electricity when supply is abundant and releasing it when demand rises. This keeps the grid flexible and reduces reliance on fossil fuels.

But how do you connect a battery site of hundreds of megawatts to a central IT platform? And how do you build software that is ready for the projects still to come? As a Software Engineer at GIGA Storage, these are the challenges you will work on.

About GIGA Storage

Founded in 2018, we are an international scale-up growing across the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany. Our purpose, ‘Unlock every Green Watt’, is about making the energy system better and more affordable for future generations. We aim to have 1.5 to 2 GW of battery power operational by 2030. At 2 GW, that is theoretically enough peak power to supply more than a million homes simultaneously.

We pioneer at a scale where many solutions are still being developed. We take ownership, share knowledge and make decisions together. Rapid growth also calls for adaptability: priorities shift and not everything is defined in advance.

Your role

You develop and grow our Giga platform. You build software in Python, working with technologies including SQL, Terraform, Grafana and data processing. You do not need to know everything already: you enjoy learning beyond your own specialism.

What will you work on? When a new battery site goes live, data on capacity, performance and equipment status needs to flow reliably into our platform. You build the software and integrations that make this happen. At the same time, you strengthen the foundations: fewer manual steps, better-documented code and reusable solutions for future sites. We work by the principle ‘you build it, you run it’. You can propose tools and improvements; important technical decisions are made together with the team and our IT Lead.

What will you do?

- Build software. Develop and maintain Python services and integrations for new battery sites.

- Make data reliable. Build and improve data pipelines, quality checks and monitoring.

- Work smarter. Automate repeatable tasks and improve documentation, standards and maintainability, using AI tools where useful.

- Own what you build. Test, deploy and support your software, and discuss technical improvements with the team.

- Add knowledge, creativity and fun to the IT team.

What do you bring?

- Higher professional education (HBO) level of thinking and working, and at least four years of relevant software development experience.

- Python experience; one year may be sufficient if you have also programmed in other languages.

- Experience with at least one cloud platform: GCP, AWS or Azure.

- Interest in data engineering and DevOps; Terraform, SQL and CI/CD knowledge is a plus.

- A broad technical mindset, ownership and a willingness to automate, document and share knowledge.

- Good English communication skills and availability to work from our Amsterdam office at least three days a week.

Energy-sector experience and Dutch language skills are not required.

Why join GIGA Storage?

- Visible impact. Your software helps bring new battery sites into operation.

- Technical variety. Combine software, data and cloud while broadening your skills.

- Room to contribute. Help automate our platform and prepare it for the next stage of growth.

- Build together. Join five international IT colleagues in our new Buitenveldert office, close to Amsterdam Zuid. 

What do we offer?

- A competitive salary plus holiday allowance (8%)

- A fixed year-end bonus (7-9%) and performance-related bonus (max 10%).

- 28 days of annual leave for full-time employment

- A pension plan.

- A €750 annual learning budget, laptop, phone allowance and e-bike scheme.

- Hybrid working: at least three days a week in our Amsterdam office; choose home or office for the remaining days.

- Healthy lunches and occasional fun activities 

Ready to build with us?

Want to develop software that matters while working on the energy transition? Apply through our website. We look forward to meeting you!

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. 

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing! 

THE OPPORTUNITY 

We are hiring a Senior Backend Software Engineer to our Identity Foundations (IDF) team in Brazil ! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

We’re looking for an autonomous and resourceful engineer to join our international Identity Foundations (IDF) team, which owns critical services at the heart of our product—including our login engine, session management, and single sign-on (SSO). You’ll build features that sit at the spine of the platform, powering experiences used by millions of users while tackling complex engineering challenges around performance, reliability, and multi-region scalability. You’ll also play a key role in driving our AI transformation, leveraging AI-assisted development to raise engineering standards, accelerate delivery, and build seamless, reliable identity foundations.

- Build and evolve maintainable, reliable, and scalable backend services that operate at massive scale across different regions, continuously identifying ways to improve production systems.

- Drive our AI transformation by leveraging LLMs and AI-assisted development tools to raise engineering standards, accelerate delivery, and elevate problem-solving workflows.

- Collaborate within an agile, people-first environment by exchanging constructive feedback on growth, successes, and mistakes to help your team develop professionally and foster a great place to work.

- Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE 

- An experienced backend engineer with years of experience building and operating production backend systems, with expertise in Kotlin/Spring and/or Golang highly desirable.

- A distributed systems specialist with strong experience designing and scaling APIs, data-intensive applications, cloud-native architectures on platforms like AWS, and scalable databases such as PostgreSQL.

- A cloud-native practitioner with hands-on experience deploying, scaling, and operating services in production using Kubernetes or similar container orchestration platforms, alongside Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to provision components like databases, caches, lambdas, and CDN configurations.

- An infrastructure and reliability-minded builder experienced in asynchronous processing using message brokers (such as Kafka, SQS/SNS, or RabbitMQ) and production observability tools (such as Datadog, Grafana, or Prometheus).

- An AI-fluent technologist who thoughtfully leverages modern LLMs and AI-assisted development tools to enhance engineering workflows and solve complex technical problems.

- An autonomous, end-to-end owner who makes thoughtful technical decisions, embraces a "you build it, you run it" mindset, and independently drives projects from design to production operation.

- A clear and confident communicator who thrives in collaborative, agile environments that prioritize people over process—comfortable influencing technical decisions, sharing ideas across teams, and giving and receiving constructive feedback.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in Kotlin/Spring and/or Golang are mandatory requirements. 

WHAT WE OFFER YOU 

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. 

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

• Lead the definition and evolution of the enterprise data platform strategy by developing, maintaining, and continuously evolving architecture standards, reference architectures, and design patterns aligned with business priorities, analytical requirements, and AI/ML enablement across data and ETL/ELT platforms.

• Participate in enterprise architecture governance forums, providing clear architectural guidance and decision support for data platform and integration initiatives.

• Incorporate financial discipline into platform architecture by guiding cost efficient design, platform right sizing, and lifecycle management in partnership with FinOps and platform teams.

• Continuously assess emerging data platform and ETL technologies, recommending updates to standards and strategy as capabilities and business needs evolve.

• Drive innovation in AI-powered data engineering workflows and automation.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

• Proficient communication and presentation skills for inter-level audiences.

• Comfortable in agile or waterfall methodologies.

The Opportunity 

We are looking for an experienced Robotics Systems Engineer (Mechanical) to join our team of product developers and robot enthusiasts. We build competitive products for our customers, and they depend on tightly integrated, complex mechatronic systems. In this role, you bridge mechanical design and system-level engineering. You own how mechanical subsystems fit into the overall robot architecture, from requirements and interfaces through integration, verification, and field support.

You will work closely with specialists from R&D, electronics, and software development to define, evaluate, integrate, and validate the robotic system across the full product development process. You will also work continuously with our operations team so that system decisions meet product target costs, manufacturability, and quality standards as ONE TEAM. Your work makes our robots more nimble, robust, and user-friendly, and opens new ways to optimize system performance and capabilities. We are passionate about excellent hardware design and system performance at competitive costs.

The Impact 

As a Robotics Systems Engineer (Mechanical) , you will play a crucial role in shaping the architecture and design of our future robotic systems. You will turn customer and product needs into system and mechanical requirements, define and manage subsystem interfaces, and drive trade-off decisions on performance, robustness, weight, cost, and serviceability. Your contributions will directly increase the reliability and attractiveness of our products.

With your innovative mindset and industrial experience, you will bring new ideas and methods to how we develop, integrate, and verify our robots. Your hands-on experience with mechatronic systems makes you key to improving and upgrading the robot’s functions. Working alongside our R&D experts, you will strengthen our ability to sustain and continuously improve our product portfolio in the field.

Market & Our Technology 

ANYbotics transforms industrial plants in the energy, process, and utility sectors by bringing robotics to a wide range of new applications that were previously out of reach. Our customers are large asset operators and industrial service providers pioneering the use of robotics for inspection and maintenance. Our mobile robot ANYmal uses legs for extreme mobility in complex environments, camera- and LiDAR-based sensing for full autonomy and obstacle avoidance, and AI for high-quality, consistent inspection results. We develop a wide range of custom hardware in-house, including the complete robotic platform, actuators, sensors, inspection payloads, charging systems, and all related mechanical hardware, and integrate it into one reliable system.

Your Contributions 

- Define system and mechanical requirements from customer needs and use cases

- Shape the system architecture and design integrated mechatronic subsystems

- Define and manage interfaces between platform, actuators, sensors, payloads, and charging systems

- Drive trade-offs on performance, robustness, weight, cost, and serviceability

- Plan and run system integration, verification, and validation

- Do engineering analyses, including FEA and tolerance stack-ups

- Monitor robustness, cost, and quality across the product life cycle, including root cause analyses and field inspections

- Work with R&D, software, and operations on specifications and design reviews

- Create system and product documentation, from specifications to assembly and user manuals

Your Profile 

- University degree in mechanical engineering, mechatronics, or a related field

- At least 5 years of industrial experience in systems engineering or mechanical product development

- Proven experience with requirements engineering, interface management, and system integration of mechatronic products

- Hands-on experience with verification, validation, and testing

- Proficient in SolidWorks and PDM environments

- Experience with FEA, tolerance analysis, and DIN/ISO tolerancing standards

- Knowledge of design-to-cost and productivity optimization methods

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Structured team player who enjoys working across disciplines in a high-tech company

Bonus Points 

- Experience with MBSE or requirements management tools is a plus

- Experience sizing standard components such as motors, gearboxes, and bearings

- Experience with explosion-proof design and certification under ATEX and IECEx

- Knowledge of the design and manufacturing of injection-molded parts

- Experience with electric drives and control theory

- Programming skills (e.g. Python) for analysis, testing, or automation

We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich.

title: Staff Software Engineer, OS Integration
description:
Headquarters: Netherlands

URL: http://www.mozilla.org 

Why Mozilla? 

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. 

About the OS Integration team: 

The OS Integration team ensures Firefox works well with the host operating system and environment. We’re a distributed team with expertise in Windows, macOS, and Linux-based operating systems. Our responsibilities include developing fixes and improvements for Firefox related to Windows, macOS, and Linux environments. This might include integration with a new OS feature or fixing an OS-specific user interface bug. Other responsibilities include native crash reporting, OS abstraction layers, sandboxing, hardening, installer, updater, device APIs, and enterprise DLP support. 

About the role: 

As a member of the OS Integration team, you’ll develop fixes, improvements, and new features for Firefox. The role will lean on your Windows expertise, but projects may have a cross-platform component. This role will include development of features for Firefox in enterprise environments especially implementation of Data Loss Prevention (DLP) features. As a Staff Software Engineer, you’re a clear communicator and expert in your domain, ready to work on multi-month projects. You’ll contribute to the team through code review, mentoring, and discussion. 

What you’ll do: 

- Improve the quality of Firefox and other Mozilla products by debugging and fixing software defects, improving the browsing experience for hundreds of millions of users. 

- Lead projects that improve the stability, security, and performance of Firefox. 

- Collaborate with experienced software engineers. 

- Perform code reviews and provide technical direction. 

- Work with a geographically-distributed development team. 

- Interact with teams throughout the organization. 

What you’ll bring: 

- 7+ years of overall software engineering experience. 

- Experience with desktop application development on Windows with C++. 

- Advanced knowledge of C and C++ and a solid understanding of assembly language such as x64, x86, or arm64. 

- Knowledge of web technologies such as Javascript, HTML, and CSS. 

- Knowledge of secure coding practices and memory safety concerns. 

- Strong problem-solving and debugging skills. 

- Written and verbal communication skills with a collaborative mindset. 

- Willingness to work effectively in a distributed team environment. 

- Commitment to our values: 

- Welcoming differences 

- Being relationship-minded 

- Practicing responsible participation 

- Having grit 

Bonus Points for experience with: 

- Enterprise DLP development or deployment 

- Open-source contributions or personal engineering projects 

What you’ll get: 

- Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team 

- Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute) 

- Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together 

- Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday 

- One-time home office stipend 

- Annual professional development budget 

- Considerable paid parental leave 

- Employee referral bonus program 

- Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country) 

About Mozilla 

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

title: Data Engineer (tbv Productie & ESG)
description:
Heb je een passie voor data, technologie en duurzaamheid? ONE-Dyas is op zoek naar een Data Engineer om te zorgen voor de nauwkeurige verzameling, het beheer en de rapportage van productie-, koolwaterstof- en ESG-gegevens. Je zet complexe gegevens om in betrouwbare inzichten die operationele en zakelijke beslissingen ondersteunen.

Wat zijn je taken?

- Het onderhouden en verbeteren van databases met gevalideerde productie- en ESG-gegevens.

- Het verzamelen en integreren van gegevens uit productiebronnen en uit geëxploiteerde en niet-geëxploiteerde activa.

- Het opstellen van duidelijke maand-, kwartaal- en jaarverslagen en visualisaties.

- Het ondersteunen van de teams Production, Engineering, HSE en ESG met gegevens ter ondersteuning van operationele en zakelijke beslissingen.

- HBO niveau in Techniek, Accountancy, Informatica, Milieuwetenschappen of een verwant vakgebied.

- Ervaring met data-engineering of ESG-rapportage, bij voorkeur binnen de energie- of olie- en gasindustrie.

- Kennis van databasebeheer, datavisualisatie en datagovernance.

- Bij voorkeur ervaring met Python, SQL of vergelijkbare tools.

- Sterke communicatieve en probleemoplossende vaardigheden.

- Een proactieve, zelfstandige en teamgerichte werkwijze met interesse in duurzaamheid.

- In deze functie werk je tenminste 60% van je werkweek vanuit ons kantoor in Amsterdam.

- Je kunt je zowel mondeling als schriftelijk goed uitdrukken in het Nederlands en Engels.

Maak kennis met ONE-Dyas

ONE-Dyas B.V. is het grootste particuliere exploratie- en productiebedrijf in Nederland. Als onder-nemers in de Nederlandse offshore gas- en oliesector streeft het bedrijf ernaar een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan de energietransitie, waarbij het vooroploopt op het gebied van duurzaam-heid en technologische innovatie. Het winnen van gas en olie dicht bij huis draagt bij aan de natio-nale economie, de voorzieningszekerheid en de klimaatdoelstellingen door gebruik te maken van lokale diensten, producten en knowhow, de afhankelijkheid van geïmporteerde brandstoffen te verminderen, de uitstoot te verlagen en te voldoen aan de hoogste milieunormen in de sector.

Met wortels die teruggaan tot 1893 in de mijnbouw, kent ONE-Dyas een lange geschiedenis van succesvolle baanbrekende energieoplossingen. Tegenwoordig bestrijken de activiteiten de volledi-ge levenscyclus van offshore-activa in Nederland, Duitsland en het Verenigd Koninkrijk, waaronder het vlaggenschipproject N05-A in het Nederlandse en Duitse deel van de Noordzee, dat het eerste in zijn soort zal zijn waarin aardgas, windenergie en groene waterstof worden geïntegreerd. ONE-Dyas onderzoekt tevens actief mogelijkheden op het gebied van koolstofafvang en -opslag, en groene waterstof als toekomstige energieoplossingen.

ONE-Dyas, met het hoofdkantoor aan de Zuidas in Amsterdam en circa 150 medewerkers, kenmerkt zich door een sterke ondernemingscultuur, korte lijnen tussen alle disciplines en een hechte band met haar aandeelhouders, wat leidt tot een doelgerichte en effectieve werkomgeving. ONE-Dyas geniet in Nederland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk en Duitsland een uitstekende reputatie vanwege zijn ervaring en expertise in de gehele toeleveringsketen van de olie- en gasindustrie. ONE-Dyas staat erom bekend zaken veilig, betrouwbaar en efficiënt te realiseren.

Geïnteresseerd?

Wil je een bijdrage leveren aan betrouwbare productie en ESG-rapportage bij ONE-Dyas? Wij horen graag van je! Je kunt op deze functie solliciteren via het sollicitatieformulier (zie onderstaande link). Zorg ervoor dat je zowel je cv als motivatiebrief bij je sollicitatie uploadt.

Mocht je vragen hebben over de functie, neem dan contact op met Gerlof Visser (Hoofd Production Engineering & HCA): 

Houd er rekening mee dat dit e-mailadres uitsluitend bedoeld is voor vragen over de functie. Sollicitaties worden alleen in behandeling genomen indien deze via het sollicitatieformulier worden ingediend.

title: Head of Digital Platform & Data
description:
PHENOGY AG is a leading innovator of battery energy storage technologies and solutions for the green electrification of the planet. Our team members work on future-proof and sustainable battery systems that are powerful, safe, and robust – with circularity as a central principle. Our technology partner network spans leading battery research institutes. PHENOGY is an environmentally and socially conscious enterprise. We are committed to fostering prosperity for the people and our planet, ensuring sustainable growth – starting in the area of our greatest expertise and impact: energy storage solutions. 

We energize the future. 

PHENOGY is seeking curious, entrepreneurial-minded energy pioneers to help shape our vision, systems, and growth; playing a key-role as we launch into our ambitious future. If you’re inspired by our mission, values, and drive to change how we energize the future — we’d love your application. 

About the Role At PHENOGY, we energize the future—sustainably. In this role you will define and execute our digital engineering strategy, owning the architecture, security, quality, and lifecycle of our cloud, edge, and data products.

Operating at the intersection of clean energy and industrial IoT, you will lead the digital ecosystem for our Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) from the gateway upward —connecting Edge/Gateway → Cloud Infrastructure → APIs → Monitoring/NOC → Customer Applications & Data Platforms. Working in close alignment with our Embedded Systems lead, Product, Cybersecurity, Operations, and Quality teams, you will turn complex energy and regulatory requirements into scalable, high-availability software and data platforms.

What You Will Own & Lead 

- Platform & Data Strategy: Define our technology roadmap, sourcing model (in-house vs. external), and application/data architecture. Establish clear boundaries, data models, APIs, and technical standards from the gateway layer through edge computing, cloud services, data pipelines, and customer/Battery Passport platforms.

- Engineering, DevOps & Quality: Lead internal engineers and external partners. Govern the full software lifecycle—from requirements and Git workflows to automated CI/CD pipelines, environment segregation, release/rollback procedures, and end-of-life decommissioning. Champion automated testing (unit, integration, performance, regression) and proactively manage technical debt.

- Product Cybersecurity & Compliance: Embed Security-by-Design via a Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC). Oversee secure coding, secrets/certificate management, SBOMs, open-source licensing, vulnerability remediation (SAST/DAST/SCA), and penetration testing across our edge and cloud stack in alignment with ISO/IEC 27001, IEC 62443, NIST SSDF, OWASP, NIS2, and the EU Cyber Resilience Act.

- Connected Fleet & Data Ecosystem: Drive high-throughput telemetry ingestion, operational data processing, analytics, remote diagnostics, gateway/edge over-the-air (OTA) updates, and secure remote access across our connected storage fleet.

- Cross-Functional & Embedded Interface Alignment: Partner closely with the Embedded Systems lead (who owns BMS, controllers, and string-level firmware) to define clean gateway protocols and data contracts—ensuring seamless integration without overlapping responsibilities.

- Team & Supplier Leadership: Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing platform and data engineering organization. Manage external development partners from technical due diligence and contracting through delivery, ensuring clean IP ownership, documentation, and zero single-vendor lock-in.

- Executive Governance & IT Alignment: Hold decision-making authority over digital platform architecture, tech stacks, repositories, CI/CD, and technical debt. Partner closely with the Head of IT to maintain a clear boundary between product software and enterprise IT while jointly governing shared domains (IAM, cloud infrastructure, networking, incident response, and disaster recovery).

What You Bring 

Required Qualifications 

- Education: Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, IT, or a related technical field.

- Leadership & Strategy: Proven track record leading software/data teams, complex engineering programs, and external development vendors, translating business goals into clear roadmaps and architectural decisions.

- Modern Cloud, API & Data Tech: Deep expertise in cloud-native software architecture, data pipelines/telemetry processing, integration patterns, REST/streaming APIs, DevOps, CI/CD automation, and full-lifecycle release management.

- Security Mindset: Strong command of secure software engineering practices, vulnerability management, and risk-based decision-making.

- Communication: Ability to bridge deep technical execution with executive stakeholder alignment—balancing speed, cost, quality, and operational risk.

Strongly Preferred 

- Domain experience in Energy Tech, BESS, Industrial IoT, Edge computing, or connected fleet platforms.

- Hands-on familiarity with Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps, C#/.NET, Python, modern data stacks, and REST APIs.

- Working knowledge of IEC 62443 and cybersecurity standards for connected industrial products.

- Experience managing high-availability operational systems and formal product lifecycle management (PLM).

How Success Is Measured You will have clear ownership backed by transparent engineering metrics, including:

- Delivery & Reliability: Roadmap predictability, release frequency, deployment success/rollback rates, platform availability, and incident trends.

- Code, Data & Security Health: Automated test coverage, data pipeline reliability/latency, CI/CD maturity, defect rates/MTTR, critical vulnerability remediation speed, and technical debt reduction.

- Governance & Efficiency: Architecture documentation completeness, supplier delivery quality, and R&D resource efficiency.

- Workload: Full-time | Level: Senior Management / Head

- Reporting to: Executive Management (CTO / COO)

We offer you: 

- Join a high-caliber environment that enables you to develop your full potential, shape your job, and take ownership. 

- Participate in the development of PHENOGY and inspire the world to transition to sustainable energy. 

- Become part of our eco-passionate expert team - a first-class team all around. 

- Benefit from flexible work hours as well as remote and on-site working in a modern sustainable office 

- Enjoy various events, an amazing coffee machine, and the occasional coffee from our CEO (acting Barista) 

At PHENOGY, we highly value diversity, equality, and inclusion. It makes our company stronger. Our philosophy: one mindset, many minds. 

For recruitment and staffing agencies: PHENOGY works exclusively with selected recruitment partners under formal agreements. We do not accept unsolicited candidate submissions from agencies and assume no liability for claims made by unauthorized recruiters regarding our recruitment processes.
