title: Senior iOS Engineer, Foundations
description:
We are seeking a Senior iOS Engineer to join Raya Foundations, the platform team that owns the shared foundation every other Raya engineering team builds on. On the client side that means the architecture of our iOS codebase, its modularization and build system, shared libraries and design-system components, CI and release tooling, crash and performance infrastructure, and the AI-collaborative development tooling our iOS engineers use every day.

This is a senior client engineering role with deep technical impact across a large, long-lived swift iOS codebase. The ideal candidate has built and operated high-scale consumer iOS applications end to end, has been the engineer other iOS engineers come to for architecture and tooling, and is excited about modernizing a mature Swift codebase while keeping it shipping every week. Rather than owning one feature surface, you will partner with the product client teams, server engineering, and design to raise the engineering bar across the whole app.

We offer comprehensive medical and dental coverage, $50 a day food delivery budget, equity based employment, a great culture, learning opportunities, unlimited vacation, 12 weeks paid parental leave, and we pay all employees $1,000 a year to go somewhere in the world that they've never been because of our values of human connection, empathy, and curiosity.

Responsibilities

Own the architecture of Raya's iOS codebase: set the patterns and best practices for state management, SwiftUI adoption, navigation, networking, and concurrency, and solve the hard client-side lifecycle problems that span teams.

Drive modernization of a large, long-lived Swift codebase: modularization, SwiftUI alongside UIKit, Swift concurrency, and deliberate management of tech debt. Write the tech specs, make the trade-offs explicit, and sequence the work so it ships incrementally.

Build the shared foundation other iOS engineers build on: design-system components, shared libraries, networking and persistence layers, and the dev harness (build times, CI, test infrastructure, release tooling).

Build and roll out the AI-collaborative development tooling iOS engineers use every day, and set the standards for how we use it on the client.

Improve client production health infrastructure: crash and performance monitoring, alerting, release quality, and the security posture of the app.

Partner with server engineering on API design and client-server state sync, and with the product client teams so new features land on solid patterns.

Raise the engineering bar through design reviews, code review, mentorship, and clear written specs.

Requirements

5+ years of professional iOS development experience, with strong proficiency in Swift, UIKit, and MVVM.

Strong experience with RxSwift or similar reactive programming frameworks, and with Redux-style state management patterns.

A track record of shipping consumer mobile apps to large audiences, with strong judgment on architecture, performance, and user experience.

Experience owning client platform or infrastructure work that other engineers depend on (modularizing a large iOS codebase, build and CI systems, shared libraries, design systems, or release tooling) and driving its adoption.

Proven ability to lead projects from concept through launch, balance speed and quality, and own what you ship after it ships.

You use AI coding tools in your daily work, help the team adopt them, and look for opportunities to improve the engineering harness.

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
Headquarters: United States

URL: http://www.sumologic.com 

Principal Systems Architect

Sumo Logic is a cloud-native SaaS data analytics platform that solves complex observability and security problems. Customers choose our product because it allows them to easily monitor, optimize, and secure their applications, systems, and infrastructures.

Sumo Logic is seeking a Principal Systems Architect to lead the design and evolution of world class platform architectures that support the company’s security and observability SaaS solutions. This role is responsible for driving technical strategy as an org-wide expert whose influence cuts across the organization. They will ensure solutions are secure, resilient, scalable, cost effective while guiding a course of action based on broad organizational goals.

Reporting directly to the Chief Product and Technology Officer (CPTO), the architect will partner closely with engineering, platform, infrastructure, security, and product teams to align architectural vision and execution. As a strategic battle-tested leader, they will direct and coordinate multiple simultaneous initiatives to deliver consistent engineering standards across Sumo Logic. The ideal candidate brings deep backend systems expertise and the ability to drive critical decisions that impact the organization and the industry at a Principal level. This role serves as the US architectural lead, partnering with architectural leadership counterparts in India.

Responsibilities

- Provide technical leadership and guidance on complex technical initiatives across multiple engineering organizations.

- Partnering with the Technical Leadership Committee, establish effective architectural review processes that ensure high quality designs that cover functional and non-functional requirements.

- Champion the adoption of modern, AI-augmented development methodologies and elevate organizational engineering maturity through strategic automation, intelligent tooling, and high-scale operational workflows.

- Evaluate and guide technology selection decisions, including build vs. buy, vendor adoption, and open-source usage, to ensure alignment with platform strategy, cost efficiency, and long-term maintainability.

- Define and enforce consistent standards for tooling, frameworks, and development practices across engineering teams, ensuring alignment and interoperability in cross-functional initiatives.

- Partner with engineering leadership to identify and address architectural gaps, technical debt, and long-term platform risks.

- Provide technical leadership required to establish long term architectural vision, and partner with technical leaders, product team, and engineering leadership to roadmap and realize continual evolution and improvements, convergence, simplification, optimization and.

- Influence roadmap prioritization by aligning technical investments with business growth, customer needs, and platform sustainability.

- Mentor and coach engineers and technical leads in system architecture, distributed systems thinking, and engineering best practices.

Required Qualifications and Skills

- 15+ years experience in Engineering, Architecture or related fields.

- Proven expertise navigating globally distributed, remote-first environments, with a demonstrated ability to drive technical alignment and foster seamless collaboration across engineering teams in diverse time zones.

- Demonstrated, repeatable ability to build, deliver, and evolve large scale data intensive cloud native architectures with widespread usage by customers.

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical stakeholders in multiple geographies and time zones.

- Extensive experience designing and operating large-scale, multi-tenant backend or distributed systems within a SaaS environment.

- Strong expertise in cloud native backend architecture, APIs, microservices, and event-driven systems.

- Experience building highly available, resilient, and performant systems running in public cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

- Strong knowledge of data architecture, messaging systems, caching strategies, and storage technologies.

- Deep experience with designing and operating complex data pipelines with Apache Kafka or similar technologies.

- Experience with data storage, indexing, and retrieval technologies.

- Deep understanding of containerized workloads and advanced Kubernetes ecosystem concepts.

- Expertise in GitOps and modern software CI/CD and software delivery practices that verify functional, non-functional, and performance requirements while balancing development productivity and velocity.

- Ability to lead complex technical initiatives and influence architecture decisions across multiple engineering teams.

- Experience mentoring engineers and driving engineering excellence within high-performing teams.

- Background in security, monitoring, observability, or data-intensive platforms is strongly preferred.

- Passion for solving complex technical challenges in fast-paced, high-scale environments.

- Deep Knowledge and experience with SRE and principles and best practices required for global SaaS operations including reliability, security, scalability, and efficiency.1

Preferred Experience

- Production experience with large scale architectures in AWS leveraging compute, storage, and networking resources and related features.

- Experience in JVM, Java, Scala, Go, Python, and TypeScript.

- Background in security, monitoring, observability, or data-intensive platforms.

About

Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness—combining agentic AI-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit www.sumologic.com. 

Sumo Logic Privacy Policy . Employees will be responsible for complying with applicable federal privacy laws and regulations, as well as organizational policies related to data protection. 

The expected annual base salary range for this position is $213,000 - $250,000. Compensation varies based on a variety of factors which include (but aren’t limited to) role level, skills and competencies, qualifications, knowledge, location, and experience. In addition to base pay, certain roles are eligible to participate in our bonus or commission plans and equity awards. We also offer a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) retirement plan, and paid time off. 

This position will remain open until filled; there is no application deadline. To be considered, please submit your application. 

Must be authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and for the duration of employment. At this time, we are not able to offer new non-immigrant visa sponsorship or OPT hiring for this position. 

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sumo-logic-principal-software-engineer

title: OrioleDB Developer (AMER)
description:
About Supabase 


Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.




About the role


We're looking for an engineer to drive the evolution of OrioleDB and its collaboration with the upstream PostgreSQL community. OrioleDB is a next-generation storage engine for PostgreSQL, and this role sits at the intersection of database internals, open source community work, and Supabase's managed Postgres platform.


This role requires strong working overlap with Americas time zones due to production support and on-call responsibilities.


What you'll work on 



- 
New OrioleDB features. Design and implement new capabilities in OrioleDB — for example, native index access methods (GiST, GIN, HNSW for pgvector), disaster recovery tooling, and other storage-engine-level features that expand what OrioleDB can do.




- 
Stability. Strengthen OrioleDB's reliability through deeper test coverage, fault injection, crash and recovery testing, and improvements to CI infrastructure. Ensure regressions are caught early and that OrioleDB behaves predictably under stress, replication, and failure scenarios.




- 
Upstream collaboration. Contribute changes directly to PostgreSQL core. Part of OrioleDB lives as a patch on top of PostgreSQL — moving the right pieces upstream shrinks what we maintain ourselves and benefits the wider community. This happens through PostgreSQL's open development process: the pgsql-hackers mailing list, public code review, and commitfests.




- 
Supabase integration. Work with Supabase's Postgres team to ensure OrioleDB fits naturally into Supabase's managed offering and roadmap.





You Will: 



- 
Design, implement, and test new OrioleDB features and integrate them cleanly with PostgreSQL's planner, executor, and surrounding subsystems.




- 
Build out and maintain test infrastructure: regression suites, fuzzing, randomized testing, crash and recovery testing, and CI pipelines.




- 
Identify and prepare patches suitable for upstreaming to PostgreSQL core.




- 
Improve performance, resilience, monitoring, and operational tooling for production use.




- 
Debug and resolve complex issues in low-level C code, including in storage, replication, indexing, and query execution paths.




- 
Participate in design discussions, architecture reviews, and code reviews — both inside Supabase and in the PostgreSQL community.




- 
Write clear technical documentation, design notes, and upstream proposals.




- 
Contribute to troubleshooting, analyzing, supporting and maintaining OrioleDB in production deployments. This can include answering support ticket requests, an on-call rotation, and supporting our team members in troubleshooting and fixing live customer production databases.





You Are: 



- 
An existing PostgreSQL core contributor or have equivalent experience in Database internals.




- 
An expert C programmer with 8+ years of production experience with focus on low-level systems programming




- 
Deeply familiar with PostgreSQL’s codebase, build system, and extension APIs.




- 
Have experience designing or implementing database storage engines, index structures, or query execution components.




- 
Comfortable contributing to community‑driven, upstream open source projects.




- 
Proficient in debugging and profiling complex C code in a database context.




- 
Able to write clear technical documentation and explain design trade‑offs.




- 
A strong communicator, committed to an open and collaborative development process.





What We Offer 



- 
Fully Remote 


We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.




- 
ESOP 


Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.




- 
Tech Allowance 


Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.




- 
Health Benefits 


Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.




- 
Annual Off-Sites 


Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.




- 
Flexible Work 


We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.




- 
Professional Development 


Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.







About the Team 


Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.



- 
~400 team members




- 
60+ countries




- 
20+ languages spoken




- 
Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)




- 
540,000+ community members





We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Global Investigator, Asset Recovery
description:
Headquarters: United States

Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

The Scam Investigations team is TRM’s tip of the spear against pig butchering syndicates, romance fraud networks, and investment scam operations that steal billions from victims each year. The team operates an integrated workflow — from AI-supported complaint triage to time-sensitive investigation, escalation, and recovery support for victims.

As a Global Investigator, you will work at the recovery-focused layer of scam investigation. You will validate high-priority blockchain leads, conduct forward and backward tracing, assess whether funds touch regulated platforms or other actionable endpoints, and produce clear investigative documentation that supports time-sensitive escalation and victim-centered recovery outcomes.

The impact you will have here: 

- Support time-sensitive asset-preservation workflows with regulated platforms and ecosystem partners.

- Own the recovery side . After a freeze, run the backtrace that ties frozen funds to specific victims and produce the documentation that drives restitution. The freeze is the start. Victim recovery is the goal.

- Trace victim funds end-to-end — forward to the wallets that consolidate them, backward to the platforms they came from. Your work feeds directly into the legal packages that recover them.

- Validate time-sensitive blockchain signals and move high-confidence matters through the appropriate escalation workflow. Speed and accuracy both matter.

- Continuously learn new issues in crypto

- Support other teams on time sensitive issues that might be unforeseen

- React timely to the movement of funds during an ongoing investigation

What we’re looking for: 

- Location / citizenship / clearance — placeholder, varies by region (NA seats: US Citizenship required, ability to obtain Public Trust clearance, US-based). EMEA / APAC seat requirements TBD by region.

- AI fluency (required) — you use AI tools in your workflow to synthesize returns, draft outputs, and accelerate analysis, with examples of how AI has impacted your work.

- Blockchain / cryptocurrency tracing (required, gating) — forward-then-backward trace, exchange attribution, co-mingling handling, multi-hop VASP tracing, and LIFO/FIFO backtrace for recovery work. Non-negotiable.

- Creative tactical thinking — demonstrated ability to pivot from a single point to a network view, identifying operators behind operations.

- Experience producing investigative packages that can support formal legal, compliance, or enforcement workflows.

- You think in outcomes, not lanes. If “that’s not what I was hired for” is a sentence you reach for, this isn’t the seat.

- You don’t need a checklist to start. Handed something you’ve never seen, you figure out the first move and take it. When the playbook stops, you keep going.

- 3–5 years of cryptocurrency investigations or asset-recovery experience — law enforcement crypto units, blockchain analytics firms, exchange compliance investigations, or equivalent. You understand how regulated platforms behave under request, including the difference between voluntary cooperation and formal process, and you treat getting money back to victims as part of your job rather than a downstream handoff.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position: 

- Surge availability expected during time-sensitive disruption windows

- All output documented in Notion and TRM’s investigative tools

- Weekly team syncs

- Daily shift handoff call

- Daily monitoring shift

Team operating rhythms: 

- High autonomy, high standards, low bureaucracy — work directly with engineering, analysts, legal counterparts, and partners who depend on the team’s output.

- Distributed, async-first via Slack and Notion, with structured syncs for alignment.

- Follow-the-sun rotation — the team runs investigators across NA, EMEA, and APAC for around-the-clock coverage.

On-Call Responsibilities: 

- Formal on-call rotation for high-priority events, such as hacks, law-enforcement support, and other time-sensitive matters.

- Weekly rotation, with occasional weekend coverage as needed.

Application Instructions 

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM 

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

- Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

- Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

- First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

- Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

- References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

- Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

- Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM 

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

- Accelerate repeatable workflows

- Structure and solve problems

- Improve output quality

- Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM 

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

- Priorities and targets to change quickly

- Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

- A high level of personal ownership and accountability

- Close collaboration across teams and functions

- Frequent, high-touch communication

- Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

- A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. 

Leadership Principles 

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

- Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

- Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

- Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission 

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore. 

Privacy Policy and Additional Information 

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy .

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com .

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form . No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates. 

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form .

Recruitment agencies 

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

The Cash Advance team owns Tilt’s flagship product, which helps users cover the gap between paychecks. Users get an advance based on their cash flow, pay no interest and no mandatory fees, and repay automatically on their next payday. Cash Advance is often the first thing a new subscriber does with Tilt, so it shapes whether they stay. It’s a live product at scale, with real users, real regulatory obligations and plenty of room to grow.

Our next chapter is making Cash Advance more useful in people’s everyday financial lives. That means getting users to their first advance faster, helping them come back with confidence, and building the foundation for what they graduate to next. Getting there requires validating ideas through focused experimentation before committing to full implementation. You’ll help lead that work on mobile. The team is lean and high-ownership. You’ll work closely with our product managers and backend engineers as you take on the mobile experience for these products.

Travel for company offsites is expected at a minimum 2 times a year. 

How You'll Make an Impact

- Drive the growth of Cash Advance: Own the mobile experience from sign-up to first advance to repeat use. You’ll optimize onboarding, conversion and repeat usage, and keep raising the bar on how users move from subscribing to taking their first advance and coming back.

- Run experiments that shape what Cash Advance becomes: Test different product constructs and UX approaches that make Cash Advance more useful in users’ everyday financial lives. You’ll work from hypothesis to launch, validating what works before we scale it.

- Operate at the outcome level: You’ll be trusted with an outcome, such as 40% conversion, and expected to improve it through your own problem-solving. That means working with design and product to find the right levers, not waiting for a spec that tells you exactly what to build.

- Hold the line on precision in a regulated product: In a regulated financial product, errors don’t just create bugs. They can trigger fee refunds, regulatory exposure and lost user trust. Your attention to detail is as much a product requirement as your engineering skill.

- Collaborate across the full stack: Partner with PMs, designers, data science and backend engineers to build financial experiences that hold up at every layer: technically, experientially and from a regulatory standpoint.

- Build across iOS and Android: iOS is your home base, but you’ll regularly ship on Android too. You’ll own features end to end on both platforms and keep the Cash Advance experience consistent for every user.

Why You're a Great Fit

- 5+ years of experience as an iOS engineer building consumer-facing iOS products. You’re strong enough to own technical tradeoffs and quality without close oversight.

- A consumer product background is non-negotiable. You’ve built products that real users interact with daily. Candidates who are mainly interested in mobile infrastructure (such as app load time or build systems) or internal tooling might not be the right fit for this role.

- Product experimentation and analytics experience. You’ve worked with A/B testing frameworks such as Statsig or LaunchDarkly, and analytics platforms such as Amplitude or FullStory. The specific tools matter less than your ability to instrument experiments, analyze user behavior and turn what you learn into product decisions.

- Outcome-oriented, not ticket-oriented. You can take a problem and drive an improvement on your own: thinking through the user journey, partnering with design, designing experiments and iterating, without needing someone to prescribe the exact path.

- Attention to detail that goes beyond code quality. You understand that in a regulated product, the gap between what you meant to ship and what you actually shipped has real downstream consequences. You build accordingly.

- Comfortable working cross-platform. You’re excited to work in Android code as a regular part of your job, not just now and then. Hands-on experience shipping on both iOS and Android is a strong plus.

Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you. 

What you'll get at Tilt 

- Virtual-first teamwork: The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You’ll get started with a WFH office reimbursement.

- Competitive pay: We're big on potential, and it's reflected in our competitive compensation packages and generous equity.

- Complete support: Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards.

- Visibility is yours : You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team — we’re a team where good ideas travel quickly.

- Paid global onsites : Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We’ve visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few.)

- Impact is recognized : Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines.

The Tilt Way 

We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non-negotiable — brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the [virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures.

You’re pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve.
